jobs.title: Software Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Torch Technologies**

Thank you for your interest in employment with Torch Technologies. We are a 100% employee-owned, Certified Great Place To Work and named Best Places to Work in Huntsville/Madison County, headquartered in Huntsville, AL. Our team provides superior research, development, and engineering services to the Federal Government and Department of War. As one of the nation’s top 100 defense companies, the services we provide directly support the men and women who serve our country. Our corporate mission sums up the pride our employee-owners take in the work we do: “Lighting the Pathway of Freedom”. And, as a Certified Evergreen ESOP, we have made the commitment to grow and sustain our company for the next 100 years! Come grow with us!

Torch Technologies Inc. is looking for a **Software Systems Engineer** to support the Air & Missile Business Unit.

  

**As a Software Systems Engineer your duties will include the following, but are not limited to:**

  

* Support the development and maintenance of requirements, interface definitions, system models, and verification criteria for complex software-intensive systems.
* Develop and update use cases, activity diagrams, logical and behavioral models, and other systems engineering artifacts using MBSE practices.
* Assist with decomposing system requirements into software-level requirements and documenting traceability, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate with software developers, integration teams, and test engineers to clarify expected system behavior and investigate technical issues.
* Support system integration, interface analysis, and verification activities for distributed or interconnected systems.
Participate in Agile planning meetings, technical reviews, and working groups; prepare technical documentation, analyses, and briefings for project stakeholders.  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* US Citizenship.
* Bachelor's degree in a science, technology, engineering, or mathematics (STEM) field.
* 5 to 8 years of relevant systems engineering, software engineering, or related technical experience.
* Experience working with software-intensive systems, such as distributed applications, embedded systems, real-time systems, or mission-critical platforms.
* Working knowledge of requirements analysis and decomposition, systems modeling, and software or system verification concepts.
* Experience creating or updating use cases, activity diagrams, interface descriptions, or other engineering artifacts.
* Experience with MagicDraw or a comparable systems modeling tool.
* Familiarity with Agile development practices and collaboration or issue-tracking tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to communicate technical information clearly in writing and presentations.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering teams and stakeholders.
* Active Secret security clearance and the ability to maintain it.
Ability to work onsite as required by program or customer needs.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Master's degree in Systems Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* Experience applying MBSE methods to complex software or system-of-systems engineering efforts.
* Familiarity with modular open systems architecture principles, integration, and interface management.
* Experience supporting defense, command and control, sensor, or other mission-critical systems.
Familiarity with the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), sprint planning, or program increment planning.  

  

**Schedule:** M-F; 8-5

**Work Location:** Customer-site

**Travel:** Yes, up to 10%

**Relocation Assistance Available:** No

**Position Contingent Upon Award of Contract:** Yes

#LI-TS1

  

**Benefits:**

Torch Technologies is proud to offer a stable and professional work environment, a competitive salary, and an excellent, comprehensive benefit package including: ESOP participation, 401(k) match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, Health Saving Accounts and Health Reimbursement Accounts, EAP, education assistance, paid time off, and holidays.

**Applying to Torch Technologies:**

Only those candidates invited for an interview will be contacted. Employment at Torch Technologies is contingent upon the successful completion of a comprehensive background check.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, citizenship, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law. Torch Technologies, Inc. participates in E-Verify.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access Careers Link as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to HR@torchtechnologies.com. Thank you for your interest in Torch Technologies.

jobs.title: Industrial Automation Controls Engineer — Commissioning & Integration
jobs.description:
**Industrial Automation Controls Engineer — Commissioning & Integration**
=========================================================================

Join Automation Solutions to build, program, and launch custom automation and robotic systems from the ground up. If you thrive on turning requirements into reliable code and machinery—and you enjoy seeing systems run in the real world—this role is for you.

**Why This Role**
-----------------

* Own the full lifecycle: from concept and design through programming, testing, installation, and post-startup support.
* Blend software and hardware daily—PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, servos, robots, and vision systems.
* Work in Birmingham and at customer sites; expect approximately 25% travel when projects hit the floor.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Project Collaboration**

* Sync daily with the Controls Engineering Manager on priorities and technical direction.
* Partner with sales, PM, controls, mechanical, fabrication, and install teams to deliver complete solutions.
* Engage customers to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and provide excellent service.
* Guide control-panel fabrication, wiring, assembly, and installation quality.
* Report progress, risks, schedule impacts, and support needs clearly and proactively.

### **Controls Engineering**

* Architect, code, and troubleshoot automated electromechanical systems.
* Create and refine PLC and HMI applications (including ladder logic) and related control software.
* Commission PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, motion (servo), robots, and machine vision; diagnose issues rapidly.
* Interpret and update electrical drawings, specifications, and sequences of operation.
* Execute hands-on integration, modifications, repairs, and system bring-up.
* Run test plans and customer runoffs to confirm performance against requirements.
* Audit for safety and code conformance; drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

### **Commissioning & Service**

* Assemble, test, commission, and install equipment in-house and on-site.
* Travel roughly 25% for installs, startups, troubleshooting, training, and post-delivery service; some overnights required.
* Operate electrical test equipment, hand tools, and power tools safely and effectively.
* Support production ramp-up and resolve controls issues during commissioning.
* Maintain thorough records: code revisions, troubleshooting actions, work performed, and configurations.
* Inspect control panels, field wiring, and equipment installations for quality.
* Represent Automation Solutions professionally at all customer sites.

### **Shop & Safety**

* Keep work areas clean, safe, and organized; assist with general shop housekeeping.
* Follow company safety procedures and wear required PPE.
* Work safely around energized electrical systems, industrial machinery, robotics, and automated equipment.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Education**

* Associate degree in Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, Industrial Automation (or similar) preferred.
* Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics (or related) preferred.
* Relevant industrial controls experience may substitute for a degree.

### **Experience**

* 2–4 years in controls programming or comparable industrial controls roles.
* PLC programming proficiency (ladder logic) — creation, modification, and troubleshooting.
* Experience with one or more: PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, servo/motion, industrial robots, machine vision, and industrial networks.
* Fluent in reading comprehensive electrical drawing packages.
* Hands-on system integration, modification, troubleshooting, and repair.
* Preferred: Custom machinery, automated manufacturing, or robotics support.
* Preferred: Electrical drawing development or revision.
* Preferred: Commissioning, installation, startup, or field service exposure.

### **Skills & Attributes**

* Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving in industrial controls.
* Strong computer/technical software capability; excellent written and verbal communication.
* Experience with Allen-Bradley, Omron, Siemens, GE, or similar PLC platforms.
* Ability to diagnose electrical, mechanical, software, networking, and integration issues.
* Clear communicator with customers, engineers, technicians, and stakeholders.
* Organized, self-motivated, dependable; able to manage multiple priorities.
* Effective independently and in multidisciplinary teams; strong documentation skills.
* Hands-on mindset for both shop and field work.

### **Travel & Field**

* Approximately 25% travel, varying by project schedules and customer needs.
* Ability to work at industrial/manufacturing sites under customer safety/access rules.
* Valid U.S. driver’s license and acceptable driving record required.

**Physical Demands**
--------------------

* Lift/carry up to 50 lbs; stand for extended periods.
* Bend, reach, climb, kneel; perform hands-on work near industrial equipment.
* Use electrical test equipment, hand tools, and power tools.
* Work safely around automated machinery, robotics, electrical equipment, and industrial processes.
* Wear required PPE.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

**Grow With Us**
----------------

* Engage with a wide variety of custom automation and robotics projects.
* Be part of every stage—concept to commissioning to sustained support.
* Deepen your skill set across PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, motion, robotics, vision, and industrial networks.
* Collaborate with experienced engineers, technicians, and fabricators.
* Contribute to real-world manufacturing problem solving and see systems you build run in production.
* Stable, full-time role with professional development and growth opportunities.

**Compliance**
--------------

* Ability to pass applicable background checks.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Description**

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. We are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. Whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or AI/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.

At SCI Technology, a Sanmina Company, we serve those who serve by delivering innovative, trusted and comprehensive products and services that meet and exceed the unique needs of the Defense and Aerospace sector. From avionics to tactical and airborne communications, counter-UAS, integrated manufacturing and cradle-to-grave product life cycle support, we deliver high-reliability solutions that keep service members connected and protected in the field.

Our heritage dates to 1961, as an early supplier to the space program in Huntsville, Alabama. Today, SCI offers a complete range of Defense & Aerospace solutions through our three business segments – Products, Systems Build, and Life Cycle Services . It’s SCI summed up - ALL WE DO to serve those who serve .

At this time, SCI is recruiting highly qualified candidates whose background and career goals meet our needs for the following position in Huntsville, AL.

**Position Title:** Software Engineer

### **Summary**

We are looking for an enthusiastic Web Developer to support a unique team within our manufacturing and test engineering department. As our Web Developer, you will collaborate closely with SQL Server architects to design, build, and maintain web-based tools that drive our fast-paced manufacturing environment. As your experience progresses, you will have the opportunity to hone your skills in full-stack development, advanced application architecture, and database integration.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Front-End Development:** Collaborate with SQL Server architects to develop intuitive web front-ends for robust database solutions.
* **Workflow Tools:** Design and build custom, internal web-based tools to support manufacturing and production workflows.
* **Code Maintenance & Integration:** Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code for web applications while ensuring seamless and secure integration between web interfaces and backend SQL Server databases.
* **Troubleshooting & Support:** Oversee application performance, debug issues, and troubleshoot user-reported concerns in collaboration with IT help desk and engineering teams.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with production teams to gather requirements, continuously improve software tools, and communicate project statuses, activities, and achievements to internal and external stakeholders.
* **Documentation:** Maintain internal documentation for custom tools, user guides, and application architecture.

### **What You'll Bring**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 1–3 years of experience in web development, software engineering, or a related field.
* **Front-End Technologies:** Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web frameworks.
* **Backend Technologies:** Familiarity with backend development (e.g., C#, ASP.NET, Visual Studio) and API integration.
* **Database Management:** Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server, writing queries, and interacting with relational databases.
* **Core Skills:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, along with impeccable attention to detail.

### **How to Stand Out**

* Knowledge of manufacturing or production process workflows .
* Advanced experience with full-stack development, database architecture, or complex SQL query optimization .
* Prior background supporting test engineering or high-reliability hardware production operations .

### **Why Join Us?**

At Sanmina, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. Your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Sanmina is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment. Sanmina provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Please be aware that this position may require access to technology, software, or technical data that is subject to U.S. export control laws. All offers of employment are contingent on the applicant either 1) being a "U.S. Person," defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident, or (iii) other protected individual, such as a refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157 or asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158; or 2) being eligible to obtain a timely export control license or license exception from the applicable U.S. federal agency.

jobs.title: Electronics Engineer 4
jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.  
At Lockheed Martin Space, we aim to harness the full potential of space to cultivate innovation, reduce costs, and push the boundaries of what technology can achieve. We’re creating future-ready solutions, focusing on resiliency and urgency through our 21st Century Security® vision. We’re erasing boundaries and forming partnerships across industries and around the world. We’re advancing spacecraft and the workforce to fuel the next generation. And we’re reimagining how space can connect us, ensuring security and prosperity.

Join Our Team as an Avionics Worst Case Analysis Engineer where you will work on the development of a sophisticated state-of-the-art avionics product in a world class Integrated Product Development environment.

**Location :** This position does not support teleworking; the preferred candidate will be located near our Lockheed Martin Space facility at one of the Coolest places to work: Sunnyvale CA or Littleton, CO or King of Prussia PA

**Key Activities you will accomplish in this role:**

  

* Lead and contribute to the development lifecycle of aerospace hardware from concept through qualification, ensuring compliance with program and performance requirements.
* Serve as a primary liaison with cross-functional peers, program management, and government customers to facilitate alignment, resolve technical issues, and support successful program delivery.
* Prepare and deliver technical presentations and documentation, effectively communicating complex engineering analyses, decisions, and recommendations to diverse audiences.
* Conduct electrical worst-case and parts stress analyses to validate design margins, ensure reliability, and support compliance with safety and performance standards.
* Collaborate within multidisciplinary teams to develop and integrate world-class avionics systems, leveraging cross-functional expertise to deliver cutting-edge aerospace solutions.

**To be effective in this role, you will need:**  

* A Bachelor of Science or higher in Electrical Engineering or related engineering discipline.
* 5+ years of professional experience with a Bachelor's.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

Bachelor of Science or higher from an accredited college in Electrical Engineering or related discipline, or equivalent experience/combined education.

Experience performing electronics analysis (Worst Case Circuit Analysis, Electrical Parts Stress Analysis).

**Desired Skills**
------------------

Experience with analog / power circuit Worst Case Circuit Analysis (WCCA).  
Experience instructing and creating training materials for Worst Case Analysis and Electrical Parts Stress Analysis  
Experience in electronic systems schematic creation and interpretation, and Electronics Modeling/Simulation Software such as SPICE.  
Experience in schematic capture using Xpedition and/or Zuken or similar software.  
Experience performing failure Investigation  
Demonstrated good communication and presentation skills with the ability to articulate complex technical issues to peers, stakeholders, subcontractors and customers.  
Demonstrated ability to work in a exciting, dynamic, collaborative team environment and to create consensus among peers and effective relationships with team members.  
Demonstrated excellent problem solving and conflict resolution skills.  
Able to work effectively in a team environment.

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $131100.00 - $243500.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

* Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
* For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer for the Space Launch Systems
jobs.description:
**Join Our Journey**

At Amentum Space Exploration Division (ASED) your growth is our priority! That’s why we offer an array of exciting opportunities for your career development. From the transformative Team Lead Academy to education reimbursement, personalized mentoring, and engaging company-sponsored networking events, you have the power to shape your professional journey in a way that aligns with your aspirations.

**Find Your Community**

At the heart of our thriving business are the incredible people who make it all possible. We celebrate a vibrant array of cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Here, we foster an environment where everyone—employees, clients, and partners alike—are treated with the dignity and respect they deserve.

**Prioritize Your Well-Being**

Our extensive benefits package is designed with your health in mind. Enjoy wellness programs, paid holidays, generous time off, employee perks, and so much more. We’re here to help you achieve a harmonious balance in your life—both at work and at home.

**Together, We Soar**

Our dynamic team consists of 10 companies united in a single mission: to venture from Moon to Mars and beyond. Join us on this extraordinary adventure!

**This position has been aligned with Amentum Space Exploration Division. To learn more, click** **here**

**Description of Duties:**

The **Senior Systems Engineer** supports SLS Program / NASA systems on the Amentum ESSCA contract.

The key purpose of the position is to plan and perform systems engineering, development, assembly, test, verification, certification, integration activities specifically for the SLS Upper Stage for Artemis IV and beyond. Provide support to implement additional requirements for the ARTEMIS and MAESTRO software including design, development, integration and testing with Upper Stage partner(s). Facilitate integration as needed between SLS Core Stage test & integration facilities and Upper Stage test & integration facilities.

Responsibilities:

The Senior Systems Engineer will provide systems engineering support to the NASA SLS Upper Stage program office at MSFC. The skills needed to support the Core Stage consists of all the skills provided to the ES53 IATF, including Simulations software developers, systems engineers, integration and test engineers, and mechanical and electrical technicians.

Additional responsibilities are defined below:

* Perform or coordinate systems engineering activities including Trade Studies and Analysis, Requirements Definition and Traceability, Requirements Allocation and Verification, Interface Definition, System Integration and test, and Design Verification and Validation. Also ensure requirements and specifications can be verified and validated, including risk mitigations, usability and NASA requirements.

* Work closely with SLS Upper stage program office and IATF software, hardware, and facility development personnel during development, understanding of configurations in development, operation, verification, and validation of IATF systems and emulators.

* Assist the project verification and validation team by defining and delivering verification and validation project deliverables.

* Identify the data that will be required to show objectively that all configurations of the product meet their requirements, as well as customer needs.

* Ensure that all test systems and equipment are appropriately validated and controlled.

* Review and analyze IATF system test data and record pass/fail results and conclusions. Ensure that results are traced to requirements.

* Measure and report on progress toward completion of verification and validation, and summarize the verification and validation performed, the data reviewed, and conclusions reached in compliance.

* Support completion of development testing, to characterize designs and understand trade-offs.

* Create or contribute to project deliverables which may include verification and/or validation plans, protocols, and reports; execution of the plans and protocols; and resolving deviations.

* Manage timeline for verification and validation activities and generate status reports.

These activities will continue as the launch vehicle architecture matures and the SLS program completes program phases, reviews and schedule milestones.

This position will be posted for a minimum of 14 days. If a candidate has not been selected at that time, it will continue to be posted until a suitable candidate is selected or the position is closed.

**Essential Functions**

**Work Environment:**

Office environment. Requires ability to provide clear, concise, accurate and timely communication, both verbally and in writing (100%). Requires ability to interact professionally with co-workers, management, and client (100%). Requires travel in the domestic USA (5%). Requires ability to work at a computer for long periods of time (100%).

**Physical Requirements:**

Requires sitting for extended periods of time in meetings with peers, management, and with our client at NASA facilities to discuss technical issues (10%). We are looking for an engineer who is naturally curious, relentlessly analytical, and driven to understand how things actually work. The ideal candidate is the person with the home lab, the engineer who takes systems apart to understand them, researches the problem until they find the answer, and is never satisfied with “that's just how it works.”

This is not a traditional single-system engineering role. You will work across a large enterprise environment spanning 28 IT engineering disciplines, helping solve complex operational problems, develop new capabilities, automate processes, and improve the effectiveness, security, and compliance of systems supporting tens of thousands of devices and users.

The problems will change constantly. So will the priorities. We are looking for someone who is excited by that.

* **Continuously improve the environment**. Identify weaknesses, inefficiencies, security gaps, operational problems, and opportunities for automation—and take ownership of improving them.

jobs.description:
**Optical Communications Software Engineer – Modem Integration** 
**Bright Silicon Technologies | Pleasanton, CA | Full time**
==============================================================================================================================

**About the Role**
==================

Bright Silicon Technologies (BST) develops precision optical systems built around our Lightfield Directing Array (LDA), a MEMS micromirror array for fast, precise control of light. Our OCTANE free-space optical communications terminal brings together free-space optics, fiber-based photonics, and communications hardware to enable high-bandwidth links between ground and airborne platforms.  
  
We’re looking for a software engineer to own modem integration and communications software for OCTANE. You’ll build the software that configures and monitors our (expected to be a COMET) modem, connects it to the terminal’s data interfaces, and manages link operation and recovery. Working with our photonics, firmware, controls, and hardware engineers, you’ll take a working laboratory system toward reliable outdoor and mobile operation, targeting Space Development Agency (SDA) interoperability.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* Own modem software integration for our free space optical communications terminal. Develop C/C++ software for modem configuration, telemetry, host interfaces, network interface and data transfer.
* Define software interfaces and acceptance criteria, including applicable SDA Optical Communications Terminal (OCT) requirements. Coordinate link states and timing with pointing, acquisition, and tracking (PAT) software.
* Implement link state machines, startup and shutdown sequences, fault handling, and recovery after fades or interruptions.
* Build Python tools and automated bench and hardware-in-the-loop tests. Measure throughput, latency, packet loss, and bit error rate to verify link performance.
* Troubleshoot problems across software, embedded interfaces, modem behavior, interfaces with the next level up in the network, and optical performance

**What we’re looking for**
==========================

* A bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, and at least three years of modem integration and communications software development experience.
* Strong C/C++ skills and experience developing and debugging software on Linux or real-time embedded platforms.
* Hands-on experience integrating communications hardware and debugging hardware/software interfaces using logs, telemetry, protocol captures, and laboratory measurements.
* Experience using Python or a similar language for test automation and data analysis, with working knowledge of communications performance measurements.
* U.S. citizenship.

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience with SDA OCT standards, compliant optical terminals, or modem and terminal interoperability testing.
* Experience with COMET or other optical communications modems, including configuration, telemetry, and host integration.
* Experience with free-space or fiber-optic communications, including optical link budgets, receiver sensitivity, and the effects of changing received power.
* Familiarity with communications or modem DSP, including modulation, synchronization, framing, forward error correction, or equalization.
* Experience integrating software with FPGA-based systems, including register interfaces and data paths.
* Experience validating link state machines and fault recovery through hardware-in-the-loop testing or field demonstrations on mobile platforms.

You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*

**Why BST**
===========

* Own the software that connects OCTANE’s modem and terminal hardware into a working optical communications link, from bench integration through outdoor testing.
* Work closely with colleagues in photonics, firmware, controls, and electronics. Follow problems across interfaces and see the results in operating hardware.
* Take meaningful technical ownership in an engineer-led company with competitive compensation, equity, and a sustainable approach to work.

**Company Overview**
====================

At Bright, we build precision optical systems to guide data for a new era of communication. Our team combines precision engineering, optical design, and product development to commercialize the Lightfield Directing Array. Applications include laser communications, optical switching for data centers, lidar, and additive manufacturing.  
Founded in 2020, Bright Silicon Technologies is building an enduring technology manufacturing company. You’ll contribute to the development, launch, and scaling of advanced optical products. **Job Description:**
--------------------

At VMware by Broadcom, we are building new possibilities for our customers by accelerating digital business transformation. We're modernizing data centers for greater agility and productivity, integrating public clouds for faster time to market, empowering digital workspaces to improve mobile experiences, and transforming cyber security.

ESXi Operating System is at the core of VMware Cloud Foundation's (VCF) virtualization technology. It is a platform built from scratch for the explicit purpose of running virtual machines and containers. ESXi is widely used by most large corporations, due to its advanced capabilities, performance, and quality.

The VMKernel Core team is responsible for the design, implementation, and architectural direction of the VMKernel – the operating system kernel for ESXi. The VMKernel Core team works across ESXi but its focus is the core kernel subsystems providing key functionality used by other groups within VMware by Broadcom as well as partner companies.

As an engineer on the core team, you will

* Learn the tools and processes necessary to become a successful VMKernel engineer and will participate in the design and development of novel operating system techniques and algorithms for managing both virtual and real computer hardware.
* Design and implement kernel locking techniques, filesystems, various forms of kernel APIs to interface with device drivers (vmkapi) user programs (POSIX) and other subsystems and invent new OS security and patching infrastructures.
* Work with multiple engineering teams to architect, design, implement and deliver new products based on the enterprise-class VCF virtualization platform.
* Take on opportunities to own parts of the core kernel infrastructures and with experience, take on ownership and lead larger parts of projects.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* BS degree in Computer Science or related field and 8+ years of relevant industry experience. Or MS degree in Computer Science or related field and 6+ years of relevant industry experience. Or PhD and 3+ years of relevant industry experience
* Strong understanding of kernel-level OS architectures such as Linux, Unix, Solaris, BSD-like systems, Windows, embedded real-time Operating Systems
* Extensive kernel-level development experience and expertise with synchronization in preemptive multi-threaded environments. Experience with Intel x86 CPU architecture and Intel based server architecture. Similar experience and understanding of AMD architecture, a plus.
* Excellent analytical, debugging and C programming skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills  
    
  Must have legal authorization to work in the US

**Boeing Defense, Space, & Security (BDS)** is seeking **Computer Systems Engineer – Space Payload Emulators** to join the team located in **El Segundo, California**.

  
  

As a **Computer Systems Engineer**, you will support the development and integration of **space payload emulators** in El Segundo, CA. In support of Boeing Defense Systems next-generation space programs, this role focuses on hands-on hardware/software development for embedded systems (Xilinx SoC/FPGA) and front-end UI/UX control interfaces.

* Implement and debug **Processing System to Programmable Logic (PS/PL)** interfaces, AXI interconnects, and memory maps.
* Develop and validate Board Support Packages (BSP), PetaLinux/embedded Linux distributions, device drivers, and low-level communication interfaces (PCIe, Ethernet, SPI, I2C, UART).

* Integrate UI applications with embedded back-end services, APIs, and hardware endpoints for real-time monitoring and control.

**Multidisciplinary Lab Collaboration & Hardware/Software Integration**

* Partner closely with FPGA logic designers, hardware engineers, and systems testers in a collaborative lab environment to diagnose issues and validate end-to-end emulator functionality.
* Drive rapid prototyping, root-cause troubleshooting, and iterative testing on lab benches and test fixtures.
* Provide technical leadership during hardware/software co-design and integration milestones.

**Job Description: Systems Engineer – Energy Systems & Embedded Software**

**Company:** NAVIA Energy Inc.  
**Location:** San Jose, California (with customer-site travel)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Travel:** Required, including vendor facilities, customer sites, and energy system deployment locations  
**Work Authorization:** U.S. Citizenship Required

**About NAVIA Energy**

NAVIA Energy is developing an AI-powered autonomous energy operations platform that integrates solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), inverters, smart load controllers, and grid-connected energy assets. Our technology helps commercial and industrial facilities, microgrids, and mission-critical installations improve energy efficiency, reliability, resilience, and operational performance.

**Position Overview**

NAVIA Energy is seeking a versatile, hands-on Systems Engineer to support the integration, installation, commissioning, testing, and optimization of distributed energy systems. The ideal candidate combines practical knowledge of solar and battery systems with embedded software development, industrial communication protocols, system performance monitoring, and field engineering.

The engineer will work closely with NAVIA's engineering team, equipment vendors, installation contractors, and customers to develop, integrate, test, and deploy complete energy management solutions at customer sites.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Energy Systems Integration and Deployment**

* Support the design, integration, installation, and commissioning of solar PV systems, battery energy storage systems (BESS), inverters, smart load controllers, meters, and associated electrical equipment.
* Coordinate with solar EPCs, battery suppliers, inverter manufacturers, electrical contractors, and other technology vendors.
* Support grid-connected and microgrid deployments, including grid import/export configurations, energy flow management, and load control.
* Assist with electrical system integration, equipment configuration, functional testing, troubleshooting, and site acceptance testing.
* Work with engineering teams to translate system designs into reliable field deployments.

**2. Embedded Software and Communication Protocols**

* Develop, configure, test, and debug embedded software for energy monitoring, control, and edge computing systems.

* Integrate communication interfaces with inverters, BESS controllers, meters, sensors, and smart load controllers.
* Develop device drivers, communication interfaces, configuration utilities, and diagnostic tools as needed.
* Support hardware-software integration, firmware validation, and system-level debugging.

**3. Software Installation and System Configuration**

* Install, configure, and maintain NAVIA software on edge computers, gateways, and customer-site systems.
* Support software deployment, firmware updates, device provisioning, network configuration, and remote connectivity.
* Validate data acquisition and communication between field devices and NAVIA's energy management platform.
* Document installation procedures, configuration settings, troubleshooting steps, and software release versions.

**4. Energy Performance Monitoring and Optimization**

* Establish and track performance metrics for solar PV, BESS, inverters, grid interaction, and controllable loads.

* Develop performance dashboards, test reports, and system validation procedures.
* Identify performance deviations, communication failures, energy losses, and equipment integration issues.
* Support testing and validation of energy management algorithms, automated controls, and AI-based optimization functions.

**5. Customer-Site Engineering and Technical Support**

* Work directly with engineering teams to prepare, install, commission, and validate systems at customer sites.
* Conduct site assessments, equipment inspections, integration testing, and troubleshooting.
* Coordinate with customers, contractors, and vendors to resolve technical issues and meet deployment schedules.
* Provide technical documentation, training, and post-deployment support.
* Travel to customer locations and vendor facilities as required.

**Required Qualifications**

* U.S. citizenship.
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Energy Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience integrating or deploying solar PV, battery storage, inverters, power electronics, industrial controls, or related energy systems.
* Experience with embedded software development, firmware integration, or hardware-software system integration.
* Practical knowledge of Modbus RTU/TCP and industrial communication interfaces.
* Experience installing and configuring software on embedded computers, gateways, Linux-based systems, or industrial edge devices.
* Ability to troubleshoot electrical, software, networking, and communication issues systematically.
* Experience collecting, analyzing, and reporting system performance data.
* Willingness and ability to travel to vendor and customer sites for installation, commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of battery management systems (BMS), state-of-charge estimation, battery charging/discharging controls, and inverter operating modes.
* Experience with grid export controls, export limits, zero-export co

jobs.title: Spacecraft Flight Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Proteus Space is a Los Angeles-based spacecraft technology company established to capitalize on a rapidly evolving space landscape and the urgent need to deliver resilient orbital capabilities to maintain and increase our national science and security interests. We combine serious space flight experience with an open minded, first-principles approach, leveraging advanced computational design and Industry 4.0 practices to deliver custom spacecraft and mission solutions with industry leading speed, precision, and reliability. We seek to enable every payload and mission with a fully custom, purpose-built spacecraft bus, designed and delivered using Proteus™, our patent-pending, automated computational design platform, with industry leading reliability.

**Role Description**

We are seeking a Spacecraft Flight Software Engineer to join our flight program team. This is a full-time, in office role for an experienced professional with a proven track record of hands-on work across spacecraft flight software (FSW). In this role, you will design and implement the software architecture that controls everything from core telemetry and bus communications to complex boot behaviors and memory management. You will bridge the gap between high-level logic and low-level hardware, ensuring our spacecraft operates with industry-leading reliability in the harsh environment of space.

**Key Responsibilities**.

● Build and maintain spacecraft FSW architecture.

● Implement new software components and communication protocols to support mission-specific payload requirements.

● Ensure the smooth operation of core system tasks, including telemetry collection, precise time-stamping, rate group scheduling, and robust bus communications.

● Develop drivers and logic for interfacing with FPGAs and GPIOs to control spacecraft hardware.

● Design and manage memory storage solutions, making critical design decisions regarding volatile vs non-volatile memory to ensure data integrity.

● Develop and implement critical boot behaviors, partition swapping logic, and fail-safe recovery modes.

● Manage the codebase using Gitlab, including the development and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and development.

● Execute comprehensive test campaigns on flatsat testbeds and flight units to verify software performance under flight-like conditions.

● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate subsystems with the spacecraft main compute element.

● Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

● Document design processes, test results, and system performance.

● Provide technical guidance on FSW architectures to fellow engineers, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

● Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science, aerospace engineering, or similar field.

● 5-7 years of flight software experience in aerospace or related fields, with heavy emphasis on hands-on spacecraft code development and testing

● Proficiency in Python, C/C++, and embedded Linux.

● Strong proficiency with Gitlab and CI/CD workflows.

● Strong ability to collaborate effectively in a dynamic environment while maintaining a positive and professional attitude.

● Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

● Must possess or be willing and eligible to obtain a United States Department of Defense Top Secret security clearance.

**Desired Qualifications:**

● Proficiency in frameworks such as FPrime or CFS, and strong grasp of core computer architecture principles including operating systems, memory architecture, and I/O interfaces

● Demonstrated expertise with hardware-level protocols (I2C, CAN, UART, RS485, etc.) and interfacing with FPGAs and GPIOs.

● Experience working in clean room environments and adhering to ESD protocols.

● Experience with memory management, file systems, and bootloader development for embedded systems.

Pay: $150,000.00 - $225,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* On-site gym
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Relocation assistance
* RSU
* Stock options
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

This role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining embedded firmware that brings up and controls board, switch, and optics hardware, including bootloaders, device drivers, and platform management firmware. * Build automated firmware build, test, and release infrastructure, and support manufacturing test integration with production-ready images
* Work closely with hardware, silicon, validation, and systems software teams to define firmware requirements and interfaces, and deliver supporting technical documentation

jobs.title: Principal Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
At **d-Matrix**, we are focused on unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the transformation of technology. We are at the forefront of software and hardware innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Our culture is one of **respect and collaboration.**

We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our **team is inclusive**, and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution. Ready to come find your playground? **Together**, we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI.

**Principal Test Automation Engineer**

**Location:** Santa Clara, Ca / Remote, US

**Role Overview**

d-Matrix is hiring a Principal Software Engineer to define and build how we use AI-enabled automation across the software development lifecycle, from build and CI through testing and release. Our codebase spans a kernel compiler, firmware, device drivers, and an inference serving stack running on silicon we designed ourselves. Tests require real hardware, correctness is numerical rather than pass/fail, and failures can originate in any of several layers. You will set the technical direction for AI-enabled workflow automation and build the foundations other engineers rely on, including the agent harness, integrations into GitLab, Jira, test results, and logs, guardrails, and evaluation methods that show whether an automation actually helped. You will stay hands-on and ship the hardest pieces yourself, working alongside a Senior/Staff engineer in the same area while raising the bar for how the broader engineering organization uses AI in its daily work.

**What You Will Do**

* Set the technical direction for AI-enabled workflow automation across build, CI, test, and release.
* Build the shared foundation, including the agent harness and tool integrations into GitLab, Jira, test results, logs, and observability data.
* Develop evaluation methodology to measure whether an automation saves time and preserves correctness.
* Define guardrails and standards for where AI acts autonomously, where it proposes and a human decides, and how every change stays auditable.
* Deliver the first Quality Engineering automations, including cross-layer failure attribution, failure clustering and defect deduplication, coverage-gap analysis, and release-readiness summaries.
* Raise the bar across engineering through shared patterns, design reviews, and mentoring.
* Determine when an agent, a deterministic tool with a narrow model step, or a simple script is the right solution, and teach that judgment to others.

**What You Will Bring**

* Extensive production software engineering experience, with strong Python skills.
* Enough Rust and/or C++ experience to understand build flows and diagnose compiler errors.
* Experience shipping AI-enabled tools or automation that others relied on in production, beyond demos.
* Deep hands-on experience with LLM APIs, agent harnesses, tool integration, and context engineering.
* Experience designing evaluations for nondeterministic systems, showing that an automation helped without breaking something else.
* Sound judgment about when AI is the right tool, including examples of choosing not to use it.
* Strong fluency across the development lifecycle, including CI/CD, testing, and release processes.
* A track record of setting technical direction across teams that do not report to you.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to compilers, firmware, or hardware-in-the-loop test environments.
* Experience building tool integrations with MCP or similar protocols.
* Experience working with GitLab, Jira, or Prometheus APIs.
* Experience managing cost and latency in LLM-based systems.
* Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot, with well-formed opinions on where they help and where they do not.

**Equal Opportunity Employment Policy**

**d-Matrix** is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. Our focus is on hiring teammates with humble expertise, kindness, dedication and a willingness to embrace challenges and learn together every day.

**d-Matrix** does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies. We appreciate the interest and effort of recruitment firms, but we kindly request that individual interested in opportunities with d-Matrix apply directly through our official channels. This approach allows us to streamline our hiring processes and maintain a consistent and fair evaluation of al applicants. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

Compensation Range: $195K - $285K

Caldera Medical is committed to improving the quality of life for women worldwide through innovative pelvic health and neuromodulation solutions. Our growing R&D team is developing the next generation of connected device technology while continuing to advance the surgical products clinicians rely on today.

Headquartered in Westlake Village, CA, with international operations in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, Caldera combines clinical insight with engineering excellence to bring meaningful therapies to market.

Do you see the whole system — and love being the person who makes mechanical, electrical, and software work come together? We're looking for a Systems Engineer to be the technical thread across our R&D programs.

**About Machina Labs:**

Engineering moves at software speed. Manufacturing doesn't. Yet.

Machina Labs is changing that. We build intelligent, software-defined factories that produce complex metal structures directly from digital design. By integrating advanced metal forming, robotics, and automated production inside a flexible factory architecture, we enable customers to move from prototype to production in weeks, not years.

Backed by Lockheed Martin, Toyota, and NVIDIA, we're building the manufacturing infrastructure that defense, aerospace, and advanced mobility programs will run on.

If you want to work on hard problems that matter and see them fly, drive, and defend, this is the place.

### **Job Description:**

Machina Labs is seeking a **Senior Electrical Engineer** to serve as both individual contributor and technical lead for the electrical systems behind our robotic manufacturing platforms.

You will own electrical design across the production cell and the platforms that follow, along with the architecture, standards, interfaces, and supplier relationships those machines depend on. You will make consequential calls on cost, schedule, compliance, and production readiness, lead technical engagement with suppliers, certification bodies, and customers, and set the bar for electrical work across Mechanical, Robotics, Automation, and Manufacturing.

The ideal candidate has led the electrical design of industrial machinery, robotics, CNC, or automation equipment across more than one machine or program, has taken machinery through compliance, and still wants to be hands-on while we grow the team.

### **What you will own:**

**Electrical architecture across platforms:**

* Own electrical design across the production cell and future platforms, including the electrical record: schematics, interconnect diagrams, panel layouts, and harness drawings, released and revision-controlled in PDM.

* Set the electrical architecture and documentation approach that can be reused across platforms.

* Define and govern interfaces between robot controllers, PLC panels, end effectors, and instrumentation under change control, and make the architecture, protection, and interface calls that affect cost, schedule, and production readiness.

* Perform, document, and set the practice for power distribution, grounding and bonding, and signal integrity analysis for 480VAC and 24VDC systems, drives, sensors, and I/O.

* Partner with the controls and software team, who own PLC and robot programming, on I/O, safety logic, and industrial network architecture.

* Lead investigation of complex and intermittent electrical problems across power, controls, and integration, and deliver root causes.

**Suppliers and production:**

* Own the technical relationship with outsourced panel and harness suppliers: release packages, approve deviations, drive quality issues to root cause, and prepare the supply base to build repeatably at production volume.

* Correct how panels and harnesses are built in-house today and set the build and inspection standard both in-house and supplier builds are held to.

* Design and review PLC and control panels for manufacturability and serviceability.

* Resolve the electrical problems that have resisted resolution, including those that cross disciplines, suppliers, and field installations.

**PCBAs and instrumentation:**

* Design and review custom PCBAs and instrumentation, and set the review, bring-up, and production release practice for board-level work.

**Compliance and machine safety:**

* Own the compliance approach for our machines against UL/IEC and machine safety requirements, and lead hardware through it.

* Lead technical engagement with certification bodies and customers on electrical matters.

* Anticipate systemic electrical and safety risk across programs and establish the design review practice that stops it before it reaches the floor.

**Technical leadership:**

* Set the technical standard for electrical work across the hardware team, including design standards, symbol libraries, and review checklists.

* Lead electrical design reviews across Mechanical, Robotics, and Manufacturing, and mentor and develop the engineers doing electrical work.

* This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required for this role. Duties and responsibilities may change based on business needs.

* B.S. in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.

* 7+ years of electrical engineering on industrial machinery, robotics, CNC, or automation equipment, including end-to-end ownership of electrical design across multiple machines or a platform.

* Experience setting electrical standards, running design reviews, and developing other engineers.

* Electronic system, device, or instrumentation design, including PCBA schematics, bring-up, test, and validation.

* 480VAC power distribution and 24VDC control: panel design, drives, PLC I/O, safety circuits, grounding.

* Industrial network design (EtherCAT, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET).

* Diagnosing or mitigating EMI/EMC issues on servo drives and sensor wiring in high-noise industrial environments (shielding, grounding, cable routing).
