New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

This opportunity is part of the **Mechanical and Control Systems Division (3500)**,which engages in research, technology development, and the creation of advanced mechanical, robotics, guidance & control, thermal, propulsion, and electronic packaging systems. We develop hardware and systems from early architecture through design, fabrication, subsystem and system-level integration and test.

As a Level V **Thermal Systems Engineer**, you will be working for the **Thermal, Propulsion, and Materials Engineering Section (353)**, which provides leadership and unique world-class expertise in a wide range of technologies and technical discipline areas, including chemical and electric propulsion, thermal, materials, contamination control, analytical chemistry, and multiphase flow. This section is responsible for design, analysis, fabrication, testing, integration, and operations of thermal and propulsion flight systems for JPL missions. This section is also responsible for providing materials and process engineering, contamination control engineering, materials testing, and analytical chemistry support to technology and flight programs. You will be a member of the **Payload Thermal and Cryogenic Systems Group (353P)** and will report to the Group Supervisor.

We are seeking an adaptable, high-energy professional who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced setting and is comfortable navigating ambiguity. The ideal candidate possesses a risk-tolerant mindset, viewing challenges as opportunities to innovate, and excels in an evolving environment where decisiveness and agility are key to our collective success.

**Responsibilities:**

* Be the JPL systems engineer responsible for overseeing specification, implementation, V&V of a flight system or payload thermal control system, reporting programmatically to the project payload and flight system managers and administratively to the Thermal, Propulsion & Materials Engineering Section Manager (3530)
* Be cognizant of the technical design, status and issues of a flight system or payload thermal control system throughout the development lifecycle (Phases A through D) assuring that thermal products and processes meet JPL institutional standards and document non-compliances
* Responsible authority to plan, direct and control financial and labor resources, schedule, make risk management decisions and performance commitments in fulfilling the project’s objectives
* Management of flight system or payload thermal risks
* Provide thermal technical leadership as an individual or member of a management team
* Oversee development of flight system or payload thermal interfaces, coordinating between stakeholders to assure operable, reliable and safe interactions between systems
* Present work in management and project reviews as required
* Represent the flight system or payload thermal system at system engineering team meetings, leading and contributing to design trades at the project system level

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering (thermal or cryogenics focus) or related technical discipline with typically a minimum of 12 years of related experience; Master's degree in similar discipline with a minimum of 10 years of experience; or PhD degree in similar discipline with a minimum of 8 years of experience.
* Broad knowledge and experience in one or more of the following areas: cryogenics, heat transfer, fluid mechanics, thermal systems design, controls theory, systems engineering
* Significant experience in spaceflight thermal subsystem/instrument engineering, and in particular experience with spacecraft thermal bus design and development
* Thermal hardware delivery experience
* Experience leading teams and coordinating working groups on projects in instrument, subsystem or bus development, test and or operations at the systems level
* Experience with development and delivery of system documentation such as requirements documents, test plans, interface agreements and design description documents
* Experience working on external procurements
* Excellent problem-solving skills
* Ability to manage multiple issues, tasks and priorities concurrently
* Experience in requirements and interface development, systems formulation, verification, and flight operations
* Excellent collaboration, negotiation, and communication skills
* Willingness to support frequent domestic travel

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience implementing a thermal control system with an external partner
* In-depth knowledge in translating spacecraft or instrument requirements to thermal requirements
* Experience in designing and implementing cryogenic (sub-4K) flight hardware, operating cryogenic instruments
* Familiarity with cryogenic instrumentation
* Experience with thermal control of flight systems or space-based instruments

* Experience in planning, preparation, and execution of flight thermal balance tests.
* Knowledge of policies and procedures at JPL and NASA
* Experience developing flight project and/or technology developments proposals
* Working knowledge of thermal environments for flight system or instrument development
* Thermal software experience (Thermal Desktop), and mechanical CA

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Union Technologies is reindustrializing America’s defense manufacturing base with a first-of-its-kind Factories-as-a-Stockpile model, integrating advanced robotics, manufacturing, and software into sovereign factory systems at scale. Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, UNION is dedicated to restoring America’s industrial strength and guaranteeing deterrence for the century ahead.

We recently emerged from stealth with $50M in funding led by top-tier venture investors and strategic partners. Read more in our Press Release

As a Senior Electrical Engineer your primary responsibility is to lead the electrical engineering, installation oversight, and commissioning activities required to bring UNION’s manufacturing facility into safe, reliable operation. This role owns the technical coordination of facility electrical infrastructure, industrial equipment power, and electrical code compliance. A successful Senior Electrical Engineer will take a hands on approach to field execution, resolve installation and startup issues, work closely with contractors and equipment suppliers, and establish electrical systems that support safe, scalable manufacturing operations.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead electrical engineering activities during facility construction, equipment installation, startup, and commissioning
* Oversee facility power distribution, including utility interfaces, transformers, switchgear, panelboards, motor control centers, and equipment connections
* Review electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, load calculations, panel schedules, and equipment requirements for accuracy and constructability
* Ensure electrical installations and systems comply with applicable NEC (NFPA 70), NFPA 70E, local electrical and building codes, and authority having jurisdiction requirements
* Coordinate with electricians, electrical contractors, utilities, inspectors, equipment vendors, and internal engineering teams to resolve field issues
* Lead electrical commissioning, safe energization, factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT), system validation, and turnover to operations
* Coordinate arc flash studies, grounding and bonding verification, electrical risk assessments, and machine safety validation
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineers, maintenance technicians, contractors, and production personnel
* Lead electrical integration of robotic cells, PLC-controlled machinery, drives, motors, sensors, and automated production equipment
* Maintain accurate as built drawings, electrical specifications, equipment documentation, and preventive maintenance requirements
* Troubleshoot power and controls faults, improve equipment uptime and reliability, and support future line expansion
* Other duties as assigned

**Skills and Preferred Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of industrial facility electrical systems and manufacturing equipment installations
* Expertise in low- and medium-voltage power distribution, protective devices, grounding, and electrical equipment coordination
* Strong knowledge of NEC (NFPA 70), NFPA 70E, NFPA 79, applicable local codes, and electrical permitting and inspection requirements
* Ability to interpret and review electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications
* Experience planning electrical startup, equipment energization, commissioning, and acceptance testing
* Strong knowledge of PLCs, safety controls, VFDs, industrial robotics (FANUC preferred), and industrial networks such as EtherNet/IP and Profinet
* Excellent troubleshooting, problem-solving, and field decision-making capabilities
* Strong leadership, contractor management, and cross-functional collaboration skills
* Ability to operate in fast-paced industrial environments and balance safety, schedule, and technical requirements
* Proficiency with AutoCAD Electrical or similar drawing tools and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio and Project)

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related engineering field
* Experience designing or reviewing industrial power distribution, electrical controls, and equipment safety systems
* 10+ years of electrical engineering experience in industrial manufacturing, automation, facilities, or complex equipment commissioning
* Demonstrated experience leading major electrical or automation projects from design through commissioning and production startup
* Experience supporting electrical inspections, permitting, contractor oversight, safety reviews, and equipment energization
* Ability to review single-line diagrams, panel layouts, and controls drawings and troubleshoot industrial systems in the field

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to:

* Walk, sit, stand, bend, lift, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, use hands to fingers, handle or feel objects, and move continually during working hours
* Lift over 50 pounds, along with over the head lifting
* Vision abilities, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust and focus
* Able to work flexible hours – including over-time, and weekends to meet customer demands

Personal Protective Equipment - *typically required to perform the essential functions of this job - will be provided.*

**Benefits & Perks:**

* Competitive pay with equity
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off and holidays
* Training and growth opportunities

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - ML Infrastructure
jobs.description:
We're looking for a **Senior Machine Learning Engineer** to build and scale the infrastructure that powers our AI-driven warehouse intelligence platform. You'll own the end-to-end lifecycle of ML vision models — from training pipelines through optimized cloud deployment — ensuring our cutting-edge computer vision and multi-modal AI systems run reliably and efficiently in production. Your work will directly enable the real-time perception and autonomous decision-making capabilities at the core of our platform.

This is a deeply technical role at the intersection of machine learning, computer vision and distributed systems. You'll design scalable GPU compute clusters, build robust orchestration pipelines, and optimize model serving for low-latency inference at scale. You'll work closely with our research scientists, computer vision engineers, and product teams to bridge the gap between experimental models and production-ready systems that operate across diverse warehouse environments. We've found tremendous value in collaborative problem-solving, thus our team works from our SF office three days a week.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Build end-to-end ML pipelines — from data ingestion and preprocessing through model training, evaluation, and deployment — and integrate them into core product workflows.
* Train, evaluate, deploy and optimize state-of-the-art machine learning models in the cloud using platforms and inference optimization techniques, including VLMs and VLAs.
* Establish monitoring, benchmarking, and evaluation frameworks to ensure model performance and reliability in production environments.

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

* B.S. / M.S. in Computer Science, Robotics, or similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* 3+ years in machine learning— developing, scaling, deploying, and optimizing large-scale ML systems from data to model.
* Track record of deploying machine learning models in production environments.
* Experience with training and/or deployment of ML models in the computer vision domain.
* Strong programming skills in Python.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Experience using orchestration systems (Flyte, Temporal, Airflow, or similar) for ML and data pipelines.
* Proficiency with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, DeepSpeed, Ray) and model serving platforms (TorchServe, TensorFlow Serving, NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, or similar).
* Deep understanding of state-of-the-art machine learning models such as auto-regressive transformers and familiarity with inference optimization techniques (TensorRT, quantization, custom kernels).
* Experience with C++ or CUDA programming for GPU acceleration.
* Comfortable with distributed messaging and compute systems (Kafka, gRPC, ROS2, or similar).
* Prior experience working at autonomous vehicles or robotics companies.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

We’re an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome teammates of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

**Benefits**

At Claryo, we offer a competitive benefits package that supports your health and well-being, including — top-tier medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k with employer matching, parental leave, and unlimited vacation.

Compensation Range: $170K - $190K

jobs.title: Hardware Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

Marvell is seeking a talented Hardware Board Design Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team, supporting board, switch, and optics development for next-generation platform solutions. This role drives execution across highly complex, cross-functional programs addressing some of the most demanding challenges in AI, wired and wireless communications, and critical infrastructure markets.  
This role is responsible for the design, implementation, and bring-up of complex high-speed boards and networking platforms that integrate silicon, packaging, and optics into deployable board and switch-level solutions. You will interface with circuit design, packaging technology, signal and power integrity, and system validation teams to define and implement board designs that meet internal specifications and customer requirements.  
You will operate in a highly visible technical environment, providing board design expertise, design guidance, and lab-based bring-up support while engaging with cross-functional engineering teams and customers to ensure platform designs meet performance, quality, and schedule objectives.

**What You Can Expect**

* Lead design and development of complex high-speed boards and networking platforms spanning board, switch, and optics
* Own PCB layout, schematic capture, and board bring-up process to achieve business and technical requirements for platform products
* Effectively plan and organize board build process, component procurement, board bring-up, debug, and testing to ensure technical objectives and schedules are met
* Drive system-level architecture decisions including power, thermals, signal integrity, and reliability in partnership with SI/PI and packaging teams
* Lead a team of hardware engineers and technicians to plan, design, build, test, and deliver boards to internal and external customers on schedule while ensuring quality
* Interact with cross-functional teams including design, marketing, software, and validation on board requirements and provide status updates on board builds
* Engage with PCB vendors, ODMs, and contract manufacturers to ensure design manufacturability, schedule, and quality requirements are met
* Perform hands-on lab bring-up and debug of boards using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other test equipment to diagnose and resolve issues
* Review customer designs with FAEs and board layout groups, leading root cause and corrective action for hardware design issues
* Proactively identify board design risks across the platform stack, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate issues as needed to drive resolution

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 10-15 years of related professional experience; Master's degree and/or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field with 5-10 years of experience

* Direct experience with high-speed & high-density printed circuit board design containing high-speed serial and memory interfaces, including DDR3/4/5, PCIe Gen3/4/5, SATA3, SPI, and I2C
* Proven track record leading small teams of design engineers to successfully complete design deliverables from concept to production
* Experience with high-speed routing including PAM4, DDR5, and PCIe Gen5, along with routing strategy
* Familiarity with Cadence Allegro/OrCAD schematic capture and PCB layout tools
* Working knowledge of signal integrity and power integrity concepts, including decoupling strategies, AC impedance targets, cross talk, insertion loss, and return loss
* Experience with larger board formats and layer counts, stack up optimization, and good knowledge of power supply design with hands-on measurement experience
* Hands-on experience with advanced test equipment such as sampling/real-time oscilloscopes and logic analyzers for board bring-up and debug
* Understanding of mechanical and thermal considerations and their impact on board design, particularly for high-density component layouts
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debug skills, with an inherent sense of urgency and accountability, and strong verbal and written communication skills

**Expected Base Pay Range (USD)**

150,680 - 225,700, $ per annum

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

**Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements**

Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights include an employee stock purchase plan with a 2-year look back, family support programs to help balance work and home life, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and a recognition and service awards to celebrate contributions and milestones. We look forward to sharing more wi

jobs.title: Staff Electronics Engineer – Hardware/Infrastructure Lead
jobs.description:

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems is looking to add a **Staff Electronics Engineer – Hardware/Infrastructure Lead,** to join our team in **Rancho Bernardo, Ca.** The candidate should be a self-starter with familiarity working in an Integrated Product Team construct. This position will be in our Avionics Integration Organization.

**Roles and Responsibilities will include:**

* Provide technical leadership and direction to a cross-functional team of cloud, datacenter, and infrastructure engineers.
* Manage the team’s Jira project: lead scrums, define sprint plans, track progress, and resolve priority conflicts.
* Maintain technical breadth across the datacenter and IT stack (compute, storage, networking, virtualization, containers, and observability).
* Develop and execute a staffing and content delivery plan per the IFC roadmap.
* Plan and release content for each IFC based on program milestones and technical dependencies.
* Coordinate with the Product Owner to groom the backlog, prioritize work, and align deliverables to program milestones and technical risk.
* Translate customer requirements into hardware, Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS), Environment, Platform and Tenant design and delivery plans.
* Define and review acceptance criteria with Product Owner and System Engineers to ensure consistent implementation and verification.
* Participate in design and peer reviews; author technical design artifacts, runbooks, and test plans.
* Decompose complex technical issues into concise executive briefs for program leadership and decision-making.
* Provide hands-on mentorship, knowledge transfer, and technical oversight during solution implementation and integration.
* Ensure configuration management, change control, and traceability for hardware and infrastructure designs and deployments.
* Perform cost account planning, budgeting and earned value management.

**The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility.** There is **NO** remote / hybrid / telework available for this position. Travel up to **25%** may be required.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) discipline and **12** years of related engineering experience; OR a Master’s degree in STEM discipline and **10** years of related engineering experience; OR a PhD in STEM discipline and **8** years of related engineering experience.
* Experience leading a team
* Hands on experience with server, storage, virtualization, and networking technologies in enterprise or defense datacenter environments.
* Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and hybrid cloud architectures.
* Strong working knowledge of network fundamentals and security best practices for infrastructure.
* Proven ability to translate customer requirements into hardware/infrastructure designs, develop acceptance criteria, and produce technical documentation and runbooks.
* Familiarity with configuration management, change control, and compliance requirements
* Familiarity with earned value management
* Must have an active US Government **Top-Secret Clearance** (with a background investigation within the past 6 years or enrolled into Continuous Evaluation).
* Ability to obtain and maintain US Government **SCI clearance**
* Must have the ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) clearance, within a reasonable amount of time as determined by business needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Current applicable Special Access Program (SAP) clearance.
* Certified Cost Account Manager
* Familiar with systems engineering practices
* Demonstrated experience using Agile tools and processes (Jira, sprint planning, backlog grooming, scrum ceremonies).
* Experience with Microsoft Visio and other Office products to express engineering documentation
* Knowledge of Cisco UCS Compute, NetApp ONTAP/StorageGrid, Cisco Nexus Networks, VMware virtualization (ESXi, vCenter, vSphere, NSX-T, Horizon) and Red Hat OpenShift
* Excellent communication (written and verbal), interpersonal skills, and the ability to interface with all levels of employees and management.

  
Primary Level Salary Range: $177,000.00 - $265,600.00The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Storage
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About This Role**

The Cloud Storage team at Crusoe is seeking a **Senior Staff Software Engineer** to serve as a primary architect and visionary for our storage strategy. While a Staff Engineer leads features, a Senior Staff Engineer defines the multi-year technical roadmap that underpins our AI-scale infrastructure. You will be a multiplier, responsible for the architectural strategy, integrity and global scalability of our bespoke storage services. You will work at the physics of the stack, bridging the gap between high-performance NVMe hardware and globally distributed, S3-competitive object stores.

**What You’ll Be Working On**

* **Architectural Vision & Strategy:** Define and drive the long-term technical strategy for Crusoe’s storage engine. Identify industry trends (e.g., CXL, NVMe-oF) and integrate them into a cohesive roadmap.
* **System Programming Expertise:** Leverage proven experience in system programming with languages such as **C, C++, Go, and/or Rust** to build the foundations of our V2 storage re-architecture.
* **Storage Protocols:** Architect and implement solutions utilizing industry-standard storage protocols such as **NFS, SMB, iSCSI, and NVMe/TCP.**
* **Open Source Stewardship:** Drive and maintain a track record of contributions to the open-source community (e.g., **Ceph, GlusterFS, Lustre, Spectrum Scale, OpenEBS**).
* **Technical Authority:** Serve as the final arbiter for critical architecture decisions across the Foundations organization. Lead complex design reviews that intersect storage, networking, and virtualization.
* **Deep Performance Engineering:** Lead "tiger teams" to solve the most ambiguous and difficult bottlenecks in the stack—from kernel-level IO context switching to global tail-latency in distributed clusters.
* **Strategic Collaboration:** Work closely with Executive Leadership and Product to align technical capabilities with business milestones, such as our imminent path to IPO.

**What You’ll Bring to the Team**

* **Cloud Storage Expertise:** 12+ years of experience building and operating large-scale, complex distributed cloud computing infrastructure products.
* **Troubleshooting & Tuning:** Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning skills; ability to profile and optimize the entire IO path.
* **High-Drive Mindset:** Self-motivation to thrive in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of ownership and minimal supervision.
* **Masters of Consistency & Durability:** Deep theoretical and practical knowledge of distributed state and data protection at petabyte scale.
* **Software Engineering Fundamentals:** Mastery of professional software engineering practices for the full SDLC, including coding standards, build processes, and testing.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Ability to champion and lead initiatives across the engineering organization, such as tech talks and technical reading groups.

**Bonus Points**

* **Public Cloud & AI/ML:** Expertise in one or more Public Cloud offerings (**AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI**) and familiarity with AI/ML frameworks (**PyTorch, Tensorflow, JAX**) and MLOps.
* **High-Throughput I/O:** Experience with cutting-edge I/O architectures like **DAOS or SPDK**.
* **Networking Foundations:** Background in **RDMA** and high-performance networking, including **SmartNICs and RoCEv2**.
* **Distributed Systems Mastery:** Experience with highly available and scalable systems such as **Cassandra, MongoDB, Redis, or Kafka**.
* **Theoretical Depth:** Strong knowledge of distributed systems fundamentals including **CAP Theorem, Paxos/RAFT, consistent hashing, and sharding strategies**.
* **Education:** Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off & paid holidays
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness support
* Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
* Cell phone stipend
* 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
* Volunteer time off

**Compensation Range**

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - ML/AI
jobs.description:

Powered by our myQ technology, we make access simple and secure for millions of homeowners, businesses, and communities worldwide. Our flagship brands, LiftMaster® and Chamberlain® , are found in 51+ million homes, and 14 million+ people rely on the myQ® app daily.

This role is central to our mission of enhancing everyday intelligence in connected systems. This role will be responsible for building robust pipelines that analyze temporal behavior, identify anomalies, and trigger intelligent alerts.

Job Responsibilities:

* Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models for detecting anomalies in time-series data from connected devices (e.g., cameras, door sensors, access logs).
* Build pipelines that analyze historical patterns and identify deviations using a combination of statistical, classical ML, and deep learning approaches.
* Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to ensure real-time model inference, stream processing, and alert triggering
* Tune models for low false positives and high sensitivity while maintaining operational efficiency.
* Develop and manage ML Ops pipelines for training, testing, deployment, and monitoring of anomaly detection systems
* Implement robust monitoring and feedback loops to adapt to behavior drift or seasonal variations.
* Contribute to overall AI system architecture and collaborate with engineers working on LLM-based assistants and agentic AI to ensure seamless integration.
* Work across product, engineering, and AI research teams to ensure scalable and performant deployment of models
* Drive decision-making around tooling, infrastructure, observability, and production-readiness.
* Mentor engineers across the org in AI-native engineering patterns, architecture, and LLM ecosystem evolution
* Manage, mentor, and grow a team of applied AI and full-stack engineers.
* Guide career development. Hire top talent and build a strong, collaborative team culture.
* Comply with health and safety guidelines and rules; managers should also ensure compliance across their teams.
* Protect Chamberlain Group’s reputation by keeping information confidential.
* Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reading professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies.
* Contribute to the team effort by accomplishing related results and participating on projects as needed.

Job Requirements:

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science
* 10+ years of experience software engineering experience with 5+ in ML engineering or data science with a focus on real-time systems, behavior modeling, or time-series data.
* Proven experience building and deploying anomaly detection systems in production.
* Hands-on experience with time-series libraries (e.g., Prophet, Darts, GluonTS, Kats, Merlion).
* Experience working with event-driven architectures, edge devices, or smart home / IoT environments is a plus.
* Familiarity with vector databases or integration with LLMs

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

* Strong understanding of time-series analysis, including: Trend/seasonality decomposition, Statistical anomaly detection methods (ARIMA, z-score, moving average), Classical ML techniques (Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM, clustering-based approaches), Deep learning for sequences (LSTM, GRU, TCN, Transformers)
* Experience in streaming data processing and building pipelines that operate on live or near-real-time data.
* Knowledge of change point detection, event modeling, and alert systems.
* Ability to design interpretable anomaly detection systems with threshold tuning, confidence scoring, and alert escalation.
* Understanding of MLOps principles, including CI/CD for ML, versioning, and retraining strategies.
* Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with ML frameworks (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow).
* Proficient in data handling and engineering tools such as Pandas, NumPy, Kafka, Spark, or Flink

Other:

* Ability to travel up to 10% of the time domestically and internationally

Preferred Job Requirements:

* Experience in IoT, software services, video, and AI
* Analytical and systems thinker who can reason about behavioral patterns over time
* Detail-oriented with a strong focus on data integrity and alert quality
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and building 0-1 systems
* Effective communicator — able to explain models, metrics, and uncertainty clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience with consumer electronics, smart home companies will be beneficial

**Caldera Medical’s Mission - To Improve the Quality of Life for Women!**

Caldera Medical is committed to improving the quality of life for women worldwide through innovative pelvic health and neuromodulation solutions. Our growing R&D team is developing the next generation of connected device technology while continuing to advance the surgical products clinicians rely on today.

Headquartered in Westlake Village, CA, with international operations in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, Caldera combines clinical insight with engineering excellence to bring meaningful therapies to market.

**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

The coolest jobs on this planet… or any other… are with Lockheed Martin Space. Lockheed Martin is a pioneer, partner, innovator and builder. Our amazing people are on a mission to make a difference in the world and every single day we use our skills and experiences to create, design and build solutions to some of the worlds’ hardest engineering problems.

The Payload Launch Site Support Services (PLSSS) Program, within LM Space, provides launch processing support functions for our government customer. Key elements of the program scope include spacecraft launch preparations, spacecraft transportation operations, and processing facilities O&M. The primary operating location is Vandenberg SFB, CA, with support of other locations also required.

* You will design, operate, and maintain Electrical propellant loading equipment, instrumentation, data collection, that support spacecraft fueling operations
* You will conduct system performance evaluations and make appropriate recommendations to modify designs or repair equipment as needed
* You will apply knowledge in troubleshooting and proposing solutions for electronics-related issues
* You will collaborate with other disciplines and departments to ensure understanding of project specifications and business needs, and deliver system level results
* You will direct the development, installation, and operation of new hardware and software systems
* You will ensure projects are completed on-time and within the specified budget

  
You will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for an elevated clearance and access to classified information.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering or in a related discipline from an accredited college
* Ability to work in a launch site environment, with the ability to climb stairs and evacuate the launch complex wearing breathing apparatus, if required
* Willing and able to support periodic travel, overtime, and alternate shifts, if required
* Must be a U.S. Citizen and have the ability to possess and maintain TS/SCI Clearance w/ Poly
* A current, valid driver’s license is required to support site travel and field operations at Vandenberg Space Force Base

**Desired Skills**

* Current experience or understanding of high value, complex Portable Propellent Loading Systems and satellite processing operations within an industrial or commercial environment
* Familiarity in CAD/CAE tools such as **AutoCAD Electrical, PTC Creo**, and **MATLAB** for circuit and system modeling
* Familiarity using oscilloscopes, power analyzers, and data‑acquisition systems
* Familiarity integrating electrical subsystems with mechanical, thermal, and software components in complex payload or launch‑vehicle environments
* Basic diagnostic skills for field repairs, fault isolation, and preventive maintenance of power/propellant hardware
* Ability to produce clear technical documentation (design reports, test procedures, as‑built drawings) that meet industry standards
* Experience working in multi‑disciplinary teams and the ability to coordinate engineering task with technicians and mission operations personnel
* Proficient with written and verbal communication skills; able to present technical information to both engineering and non‑technical stakeholders
* Familiarity with IBM Maximo (or comparable CMMS) for equipment tracking, work‑order creation, and maintenance history management.
* Active Security+ Certification
* Active TS/SCI Clearance w/ Poly
* Possess practical Electrical Engineering operations and/or maintenance experience within an industrial or commercial environment

Full-Time Salary Range: $65500.00 - $121700.00

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

**About the Role:**

CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity.

The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.

This is a **Sr. Software Development Engineer II** (SDE) role in the **CTIO** team that is bringing multiple AI-based strategies together into an integrated capability on our next-generation sensor (lightweight agent) across macOS, Linux, and Windows platforms. The Sr. SDEs in the team own the design and development of the features that put AI on the endpoint: operationalizing machine learning models inside the sensor, building the data pipelines that collect, transform and deliver sensor telemetry for model training, evaluation and on-device inference, and integrating those capabilities with the core sensor features. Features will cross-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, process, and networking, and many are built with shared components across platforms. The team operates under the Agile development principles and ships frequently.

The **CTIO** team at CrowdStrike is responsible for defining and executing the company's technology vision and strategy, driving innovation and overseeing the development and evolution of the Falcon platform. The CTIO ensures CrowdStrike maintains its position as a technology leader by fostering engineering excellence, aligning technical capabilities with business objectives, and anticipating emerging threats and market trends.

**What You’ll Do:**

  

* Collaborate with all the sensor development teams, across the company, on architecture and strategic initiatives.
* Conceptualize and develop new product features.
* Provide guidance and support to development teams in designing and implementing software for cross-platform delivery (Windows, macOS, Linux).
* Take ownership of features throughout the entire lifecycle, from initial design to final delivery, including presenting product demonstrations at the conclusion of each sprint.
* Engage in cross-functional collaboration with teams situated in various locations.

**What You’ll Need:**

  

* Deep knowledge of C/C++; Swift experience required for macOS-focused candidates; Windows OS Kernel and Driver Development experience required for Windows-focused candidates.
* Hands-on experience operationalizing machine learning models on the endpoint, including building the data pipelines that collect, transform and deliver sensor telemetry for model training, evaluation and on-device inference.
* Extensive, fundamental understanding of internals for your primary platform (macOS, Linux, or Windows)
* Proven experience in debugging memory corruption issues, process contentions, and system performance bottlenecks.
* Demonstrated experience collaborating with teams to successfully deliver major features and releases.
* Ability to lead, mentor, communicate, collaborate, and operate effectively within a geographically distributed team.

**Bonus Points:**

  

* Demonstrated strong background in developing scalable, light-weight, and highly performing systems
* In-depth OS system expertise regarding core concepts and subsystems
* Familiarity and experience utilizing Agile methodologies
* Knowledge of security principles

jobs.description:
**Work at Blissway: Opportunity for Impact Every Day**

Blissway is a startup that simplifies toll collection and dramatically improves highway safety. We are multiple startups in one: **Deep Tech, AI/ML, Hardware, SaaS, and IoT.** For the past five years, we have built a nearly insurmountable technological lead in tolling, a roughly $200B global industry expected to double in the next decade. We work for toll authorities and state DOTs, and we own the whole system, from the roadside camera to the final bill, so every vehicle we see becomes one accurate toll transaction and nothing more. While our competitors have thousands of employees, we operate with a lean but growing team of less than 30. Our impact is visible on the massive Interstate Highway System connecting every major US metro (except Juneau, AK—sorry, Juneau).

**You are a good fit if...**

* **You love the grind:** You take ownership and put in the time to meet deadlines. Our recent team survey showed an average of 55 hours/week, with occasional 70+ hour bursts for major releases.
* **You are detail obsessed:** You have experience writing code, designing or building systems that stands up to the unpredictability of the physical world, where the small details are the difference between success and failure.
* **You are adaptable:** We are a lean team. If you only want to work on a "niche thing" or are uncomfortable helping other teams when they need a boost, this isn't the place for you. We expect you to figure out what you need to get stuff done.

* **You're not afraid to code:** This is a hardware-centered role but most of our teammates have broad skillsets that allow them to build what they need, including code to help make our hardware more effective. At minimum you should be comfortable sketching what you need and collaborating with software engineers to build it. We mostly use Python, but we don’t care what you’re most proficient in today as long as you learn fast.
* **You value working together in person:** You’re excited to work alongside the team at our Denver office. This role is in-office five days a week, Monday through Friday, with flexibility to work remotely occasionally when needed.

**The Mission: From Theory to High-Traffic Reality** At a team of less than 30, we don't have "junior" tasks. You will be given immediate ownership over the hardware that keeps the Interstate Highway System running. You will use the basics of electrical, mechanical, and software engineering to:

* **Optimize the Edge:** Improve the reliability of cameras, detectors, and night-time illuminators that survive 24/7 exposure.
* **Prototyping & R&D:** Design circuit schematics and PCBs for new hardware integrations that push our device performance further.
* **Full-Stack Hardware:** Write the on-device code (Python/C++) to integrate new sensors and ensure the servers can handle the incoming data.

* **Technical Versatility:** You have a foundational understanding of circuit design and CAD, but you aren't afraid to write code. You should be comfortable (or eager to become comfortable) in Python or C++ to make your hardware talk to our software.
* **Mindset:** You take extreme ownership. You don't wait for a manual or a step-by-step guide; you figure out what you need to get stuff done and you do it with a professional, collaborative mentality. You understand that in a small team feedback is the fastest way to level up, and you welcome it.

**Our Technical Ecosystem:** While we value problem-solving over specific syntax, skills that transfer well are:

* **Languages:** Python, TypeScript, C/C++
* **Tools: Altium,** Onshape, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers
* **Infrastructure:** Linux, IoT Edge Devices, AWS
* **Specialties:** Edge Computer Vision, CAD, weatherproofing, outdoor deployment, vertical product integration

**The Interview Process**

We're a selectively small team, which means a deliberate and thorough interview process with 3-4 interviews and a final paid work trial. In exchange, you get real autonomy from day one, direct access to the people setting technical direction, and work that ships to roads in weeks, not quarters.

* **Investing in Your Future:** 401(k) matching up to 4%.

jobs.title: Associate Laser Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At Infleqtion we solve the world’s most challenging problems using cutting-edge quantum technology. Our mission is to commercialize atom-based quantum products that provide orders of magnitude improvements in sensing and computing applications. We are proud to work tirelessly to create and lead the quantum ecosystem towards meaningful advancements today and set the technology roadmap for tomorrow.

POSITION SUMMARY

Within Infleqtion’s Quantum Computing Product Group, the Hardware Engineering Team is seeking an Associate Laser Systems Engineer for neutral-atom quantum computing hardware. You will carry out well-defined laser assembly, characterization and control tasks, building practical judgment through laboratory work and design reviews. You’ll have dedicated time for technical learning and hands-on training, supported by regular guidance from experienced engineers.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Typically, you will be entrusted with:

 Assemble and align assigned laser paths using reviewed layouts and laser-safety procedures.

 Calculate expected power levels and frequency shifts for assigned setups, and compare predictions with measurements.

 Measure laser power, polarization, beam profiles and short-term stability against provided acceptance criteria.

 Set up detectors, modulation stages and feedback controls using reviewed procedures; record their response and operating settings.

 Work with engineers to isolate alignment, signal or lock problems, test fixes and flag issues beyond the assigned scope.

 Record setup changes, measurements and test conditions so others can reproduce the work; submit procedure improvements for review.

 Plan assigned tasks, report progress and blockers, and incorporate feedback from design and test reviews.

 **Requirements**

WE HOPE YOU HAVE:

 Bachelor’s degree in optical engineering, physics, electrical engineering or a related field. Prior industry experience is not required.

 Understanding of laser and optical fundamentals, with practice explaining beam propagation, polarization, interference and frequency.

 Hands-on practice assembling an optical or electro-optical setup and taking measurements while following laboratory safety procedures.

 Practice interpreting detector signals and explaining how gain, noise and negative feedback affect a measurement or control loop.

 Experience analyzing measurements, comparing them with predictions and explaining differences using calculations, spreadsheets or scripts.

 Experience keeping accurate setup and measurement records, checking work for errors and flagging unexpected results.  Experience explaining technical work clearly, raising questions or problems early, and incorporating feedback.

WE HIGHLY VALUE:

 Project experience with laser characterization, optical modulation or feedback control.

 Experience using Python or comparable tools to collect and analyze laboratory data.

 Experience with atomic spectroscopy, optical resonators or low-noise photodetection

Coursework, laboratory classes, research, internships and projects can demonstrate these skills. Preferred qualifications are helpful, not required.

NOTE

 Job responsibilities and requirements are illustrative, other responsibilities may be assigned as needed.

 This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Please note that any offer for employment may be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations without sponsorship for an export license.

TRAVEL Up to 10% travel may be required.

WORKING CONDITIONS and PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS Work will normally be performed in an office and laboratory environment and around technical equipment including computers and lasers. Able to sit, stand, bend, lift and carry up to 40 pounds without assistance. Able to efficiently use automated office equipment such as laptops, copiers, and printers; able to effectively engage in communications (via phone, computer, or in-person). Any required Personal Protective Equipment will be provided and must be properly used in accordance with company requirements

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Defibtech is seeking a Senior Manufacturing Software Engineer responsible for production tools, databases, platforms, and test station software used in the manufacture of medical devices, which are deployed both on site and at Defibtech’s contract manufacturers. This role is primarily focused on software design and maintenance to support new products, sustain products, and make process improvements to our production tools and systems. This role is based onsite at our Branford, CT manufacturing location, hybrid capable.

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Supports and implements updates on-site and at contract manufacturing sites to support Defibtech production systems.
* Develops and maintains production tools and systems, which are used to interface with Defibtech devices and test equipment, program and test the devices, generate labels, and automate recording of test data. Software development is inclusive of coding, sandbox testing, documentation, writing and executing test protocols, and managing release of the code through the Engineering Change process, all according to quality and regulatory requirements.
* Performs test station environment and database qualifications and supports verification and validation testing as required.
* Serves as central contact for production and pilot test station setup and troubleshooting.
* Generates and executes data queries in support of production investigations.
* Participates in cross-functional teams and facilitates the transfer of development projects into the manufacturing production test environment.
* Identifies and implements improvements in both database and software development processes and develops and implements new software for new product rollouts, as required.
* Supports and leads investigations, including identification of root cause and implementation of corrective or preventative actions using various Defibtech processes (CAPA, PAF, SCAR, etc.).
* Creates and manages documentation utilizing Defibtech’s Change Control process, including ECR/ECO, station specifications, documents, and test protocols.
* Demonstrates Defibtech’s values on the job. Promotes and participates in continuous improvement.
* Actively supports compliance of Company operations to all applicable laws, regulations and standards, good business practices and company documented procedures (including but not limited to FDA, Quality Management Systems Regulations, safety regulations, and applicable statutes).

**Qualifications / Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related degree and at least 5 years of relevant experience OR the equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience.
* PC hardware, Windows OS, and peripherals experience required.
* Preferred candidates will have experience in a Manufacturing / Test support environment, embedded software, and/or SQL Server, Visual Basic, C# or similar experience.
* Medical Device product/industry experience including development operating under ISO 13485, highly preferred.
* Ability to operate independently, lead project initiatives related to manufacturing, make decisions, influence outcomes, and drive tasks to successful completion.
* Ability to establish and support hardware platform interface and peripherals communication using software applications is desirable.
* Strong written and oral communication skills to accurately convey issues and information.
* Ability to multi-task and work in a fast paced, high-volume environment.

**Work Environment and Physical Demands:**

* Work environment is based within office and light manufacturing setting.
* Light work that includes moving objects up to 20 lbs; frequent sitting, walking, and standing.

**Compensation:**

**Benefits:**

* Defibtech offers a comprehensive benefits package including health and wellness benefits, company-paid disability & life insurance, and 401k with company matching contribution and more.
* Defibtech promotes a challenging, collaborative, and friendly culture that is centered around our values and mission.
* Defibtech is supportive of work balance, providing company gatherings to add fun and generous paid time off and flexibility for employees to manage time and responsibilities.
* Defibtech is committed to empowering and supporting our employees in their philanthropic efforts through donation programs and time off for volunteerism.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.*

We provide fair and equal employment and advancement opportunities for all employees and candidates regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.*

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building the next generation of software systems that enable data center operations to scale with the speed, reliability, and efficiency required by modern cloud infrastructure.
  
  
We are looking for a \*\*Principal Software Development Engineer (IC4)\*\* to help design, build, and operate software platforms that support Cloud Hardware Support (CHS) as OCI continues to grow. This role focuses on cloud-native systems, operational tooling, workflow automation, analytics, and intelligent user experiences that help teams manage data center work more consistently and efficiently.
  
  
As an IC4 engineer, you will operate independently while helping guide the team’s technical direction. You will build entire systems and services, drive design across complex features and subsystems, improve engineering and operational practices, and collaborate closely with partner teams across infrastructure, operations, and service engineering. This aligns with the IC4 expectation of independently building systems and services while improving engineering practices, operations, ownership, hiring, and mentoring across a director-level organization.
  
  
This role is well suited for an engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous operational problems with scalable software. You will work on platforms that unify task execution, workflow orchestration, inventory and asset interactions, guided procedures, operational analytics, and automation-first experiences for data center support teams. The broader CHS roadmap emphasizes reducing manual, fragmented processes; improving repair throughput and quality; building centralized analytics; and establishing a task-centric repair operator platform as a primary system of work.
  
  
Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, ownership of production systems, customer empathy for field and operations users, and the ability to design software that is secure, resilient, observable, and scalable across global environments.

  

**As a Principal Software Development Engineer, you will:**  
  
**Design, develop, and operate scalable cloud-native services, APIs, and platforms that support OCI data center growth, repair operations, and infrastructure management.**  
  
**Build software that simplifies complex operational workflows through automation, guided task execution, intelligent prioritization, and self-service tooling.**  
  
**Lead the design of major features and subsystems across task management, inventory workflows, analytics, workflow orchestration, integrations, and operational dashboards.**  
  
**Create reliable systems that integrate with multiple backend sources of truth while presenting users with a unified, consistent, and intuitive experience.**  
  
**Develop platforms that improve technician productivity, reduce manual work, increase operational consistency, and support faster issue resolution.**  
  
**Partner with product, operations, infrastructure, and service teams to translate complex data center workflows into scalable software capabilities.**  
  
**Drive operational excellence through observability, alerting, automated validation, resilient architecture, and measurable service health.**  
  
**Build analytics and telemetry capabilities that help identify workload trends, bottlenecks, quality issues, operational risks, and opportunities for automation.**  
  
**Improve engineering quality by contributing to architecture reviews, design standards, testing practices, deployment safety, and production readiness.**  
  
**Work independently on complex projects while seeking input when tradeoffs affect customers, business goals, system architecture, or cross-team dependencies, consistent with IC4 expectations.**  
  
**Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation guidance, operational best practices, and technical decision-making.**  
  
**Champion secure, maintainable, and extensible software that can scale across global OCI data center environments.**

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and run the platform behind our certificate management, TLS and vulnerability monitoring, uptime, and security products. The platform is a TypeScript monorepo: Fastify and Express services, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL and Redis, queues and workers on AWS, deployed to Kubernetes through Terraform, Helm, and Azure DevOps pipelines. It also carries a legacy .NET estate that we are steadily retiring, and a growing set of AI-assisted features and internal tooling.

You will own features end to end, from schema and API through UI, pipeline, and production. We work in a small team with a lot of surface area, so the job rewards engineers who pick up whatever the problem needs, whether that is a new framework, a scanner's quirks, or a cloud primitive they have not touched before

**What you will do**

* Design, build, and ship features across the full stack: Fastify or Express APIs, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL schemas and migrations, SQS-driven workers, and the infrastructure that runs them.
* Own services in production: observability with Sentry and Grafana, on-call participation, incident root-causing, and the follow-through fixes.
* Build and evolve security and monitoring products that scan, probe, and score real customer infrastructure at scale, with correctness and performance budgets that matter.
* Maintain and incrementally retire legacy .NET and Python components, moving behavior into the TypeScript platform with parity verified rather than assumed.
* Extend CI/CD and infrastructure: Azure DevOps pipelines, Docker images, Helm charts, and Terraform for EKS, RDS, SQS, and related AWS services.
* Integrate third-party and partner APIs (certificate authorities, scanners, identity providers) and keep those integrations resilient.
* Use AI-assisted development tools as part of daily work, and build AI-backed features where they genuinely improve the product.
* Review code, write tests, and raise the bar on standards that apply to human and AI-generated code alike.
* Mentor other engineers and write up decisions so others can act on them without you in the room.

  

**What you will have**

* 6+ years building and operating production web services and the frontends on top of them.
* Strong TypeScript and Node.js, including a modern API framework (Fastify preferred, Express acceptable) and a React framework (Next.js preferred).
* Production experience in more than one language or ecosystem, and at least one stack change you drove or adapted to in the last few years. Depth in a single language is not enough for this role.
* Solid relational database skills on MySQL or Postgres: schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance, and transaction and locking behavior.
* Comfort owning what you ship: logging, metrics, alerting, and calm, evidence-led debugging in production.
* Security awareness as a habit: authentication and authorization flows, secrets handling, input validation, and dependency hygiene.
* Clear written communication. You can explain a design, a trade-off, or an incident to engineers and non-engineers.

  

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on AWS (compute, queues, storage, secrets) and the ability to read and change Terraform.
* Containers and Kubernetes at a working level: writing a Dockerfile, reading a Helm chart, debugging a failing pod.
* CI/CD pipeline work in Azure DevOps or similar, plus Cloudflare or AWS WAF experience.
* Grafana, Sentry, or equivalent observability tooling beyond basic dashboards.
* Experience with PKI, TLS, or certificate lifecycle management, or with monitoring and scanning products (uptime, vulnerability, DNS or email security).
* OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect implementation experience, especially multi-tenant identity providers.
* C# and .NET, enough to read, maintain, and migrate legacy services without making them your home.
* Python for data pipelines, scanners, or tooling.
* Large-scale scanning or crawling systems: fleets of workers, rate limits, timeouts, and the cost math behind them.
* Building with LLM APIs, MCP servers, or agentic workflows in a product context.

  

**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation and comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
* Retirement savings programs with company matching (401(k) or RRSP)
* Generous paid time off, including holidays, and vacation
* Paid parental leave and family support benefits
* Life and disability coverage
* Flexible spending and health savings options (where applicable)
* Health and wellness support, including gym reimbursement and wellness programs
* Employee Assistance Program with 24/7confidential support for employees and families
* Education assistance and professional development opportunities
* Access to LinkedIn Learning and continuous learning resources
* Employee referral bonus program and additional company perks and discounts
* Internal rewards and recognition platform (Motivosity) to celebrate and acknowledge project wins, milestone achievements, and the outstanding contributions of our colleagues
* Business travel insurance and global employee support programs

To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. Resumes or CVs sent directly via email will not be reviewed or considered.

The Georgia Tech Research Institute (GTRI) is the nonprofit, applied research division of the Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech). Founded in 1934 as the Engineering Experiment Station, GTRI has grown to more than 2,900 employees, supporting eight laboratories in over 20 locations around the country and performing more than $940 million of problem-solving research annually for government and industry. GTRI's renowned researchers combine science, engineering, economics, policy, and technical expertise to solve complex problems for the U.S. federal government, state, and industry.

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

Degree required

jobs.description:
Fairmount Technologies (FT) is a growing advanced manufacturing company developing **tooling-free CNC systems** for aerospace and defense applications. Our mission is to integrate real-time automation directly onto the factory floor, ensuring unprecedented precision, safety, and efficiency in aerospace component production.

**Recent milestone:** FT was selected for a U.S. Department of Defense **APFIT award**, supporting deployment of our systems across multiple Air Force maintenance depots. As we scale production and system capability, we’re expanding our software team.

We are seeking a versatile **Senior Software Engineer** to bridge the gap between robust industrial hardware and advanced artificial intelligence.

**Position Overview**

In this role, you will build and modernize **Human-Machine Interface (HMI)** desktop applications that control and monitor complex CNC machining systems. You will use **C#** to drive high-performance, real-time desktop UIs and **Python** to deploy predictive machine learning models at the edge. This role is critical to transforming raw machine telemetry into actionable, intelligent automation on the shop floor.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Next-Gen HMI Development:** Design, scale, and optimize high-performance desktop interfaces that connect operator control systems directly with CNC machinery.
* **UI Modernization:** Maintain and enhance legacy **WinForms** developed on **WPF** applications, while actively pioneering migrations to modern, fluent architectures like **WPF** or **WinUI** and cross-platform ecosystems like **Avalonia**.
* **Edge Machine Learning Integration:** Deploy, test, train, and optimize PyTorch and **TensorFlow** models inside production environments to handle anomalies, predict tool wear, and automate vision-based quality control in addition to predicting part deviations.
* **Hybrid Data Architecture:** Build and manage data layers that combine structured configuration/part logs with scalable NoSQL (**MongoDB**) for high-frequency time-series sensor data.
* **Hardware-Software Synthesis:** Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and automation engineers to ingest CNC controller data seamlessly into your application workflows.

**Technical Requirements**

**Desktop & HMI Frameworks (C#)**

* **Advanced WPF :** Deep expertise in Windows desktop environments, including MVVM architecture, multithreading, custom control rendering, and memory management.
* **WinUI & Avalonia:** Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of building fluid Windows 11 apps and cross-platform desktop interfaces (Windows/ UI deployment).

**Machine Learning & Intelligence (Python)**

* **PyTorch & TensorFlow:** Practical experience deploying and inferencing machine and deep learning models in real-world environments.
* **Python Engineering:** Mastery of Python for analytics pipelines, sensor data preprocessing, and scripting to communicate with C# backends.

**Databases & Telemetry**

* **SQL:** Strong proficiency in relational database schema design, indexing, and complex queries (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
* **MongoDB:** Solid understanding of NoSQL concepts for managing semi-structured telemetry, time-series data, and machine logs.

**Qualifications & Preferred Skills**

* **Experience:** 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a heavy emphasis on desktop engineering and heavy data/AI application integration.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Previous experience with manufacturing execution systems (MES), CNC controllers (Beckhoff preferred or similar systems like Fanuc, Siemens), or aviation/aerospace safety standards is a massive plus.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, or a related field.
* **Mindset:** A strict commitment to software reliability, code safety, and high-precision execution required for manufacturing environments.

**Regulatory & Location Requirements**

**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**NEUTRON**

Neutron is a medium-lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high-assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will provide a cost-effective and reliable launch solution by leveraging Rocket Lab's proven execution history with the Electron program. If you're interested in joining a high-performing team and pushing the boundaries with a clean-sheet development of a reusable liquid launch vehicle, this is your opportunity!

**SENIOR ELECTRICAL ENGINEER – MARINE OPERATIONS**

We are currently seeking an Electrical Engineer based out of Rocket Lab's Space Structures Complex in Middle River, Maryland. You will be responsible for the design, specification, analysis, and execution of power distribution, navigation systems, controls, and communications systems on our recovery vessel.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Serve as the electrical engineering technical expert within the Marine Operations team, enabling recovery and reusability of Neutron

* Design critical electrical infrastructure, including schematics, layout, and routing for power, lighting, navigation, instrumentation, propulsion, and communications systems

* Coordinate with other Rocket Lab engineers to ensure electrical systems are well integrated with the other vessel systems

* Ensure all systems meet regulatory requirements (ABS, USCG, IEC, NFPA, FCC)

* Conduct design reviews to ensure systems meet requirements, identify risks, resource needs, and schedule estimates

* Work onboard the vessel during construction, ensuring build-out meets engineering specifications, and drive future modifications to enable more efficient mission execution

* Collaborate with the marine engineering group for commissioning and sea-trials test planning

* Troubleshoot and validate electrical systems during commissioning

* Oversee the operation, sustainment, troubleshooting, and repair of critical electrical power and control systems

* Build and manage electrical and electronic spares inventory and maintain minimum inventories of those onboard parts and components.

**YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS AN ELECTRICAL ENGINEER:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or marine engineering

* 3+ years of experience as an electrical engineer, preferably in the maritime industry, with exposure to large vessels and autonomous or automated vessel systems

* Technical project management experience and the ability to liaise with external suppliers
