jobs.title: Staff Embedded Linux Engineer
jobs.description:
Full-Time

In Person: Boston, MA Headquarters

*Step into a foundational engineering role at a fast-growing grid intelligence company.*

We are seeking a **Staff Embedded Linux Engineer** to join our customer focused team, take charge of the Linux kernel, drivers, and bootloader beneath our current technology, and shape the embedded architecture of future generation products.

LineVision’s customers include eight of the ten largest US utilities, which rely on field deployed device sensors to run securely and reliably. You will work on ruggedized, solar-powered sensors mounted on poles away from the transmission lines they monitor. Each pairs a Linux compute module with a companion microcontroller, connects over cellular, and must run for years without a site visit.

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Embedded Software Engineering, you will have broad autonomy over kernel and bootloader maintenance, security patching, board bring-up, system software improvements, and device security, including secure boot. You will bridge a hardware-focused embedded team with Data Science and Computer Vision, moving algorithms onto the device and raising the team’s software depth, delivering LineVision devices that are lean, secure, and ready for what comes next.

Please note: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

### **Core Responsibilities and Key Performance Objectives**

* Maintain the Linux kernel and bootloader on LineVision devices, including security patching, driver development, and operating system improvements
* Lead board bring-up on new hardware platforms, from first boot through production
* Drive system software improvements across the device platform, including performance, power efficiency, and reliability
* Design hardware-level device security, including secure boot and factory-signed software, with hardware and manufacturing teams
* Work with Data Science and Computer Vision to adapt algorithms for low-footprint, on-device execution, using the NPU, GPU, and other hardware blocks where they save CPU and power
* Own the Linux BSP and build system for the platform, including device trees, OS image releases, and the kernel and bootloader upgrade strategy
* Lead root cause analysis on cross-layer problems such as kernel crashes, power and thermal behavior, and field or manufacturing failures that span hardware and software
* Influence SoC, module, and peripheral selection for future hardware, weighing Linux support, vendor BSP quality, long-term maintainability, and security features
* Set technical standards for embedded Linux through design reviews, code review, and mentoring, and act as the technical resource for engineers across hardware, firmware, and cloud application software

### **Within the first 3 months:**

* Assume day-to-day responsibility for kernel, driver, and bootloader work, with a documented security patching process
* Baseline current system performance, including boot time, shutdown time, and power draw
* Review the platform’s kernel, bootloader, and security posture and present a prioritized technical roadmap to Engineering leadership

### **Within the first 6 months:**

* Ship production system software improvements with measurable gains against the baseline
* Define the device security architecture and roadmap with Hardware Engineering, Manufacturing, and the security team, covering secure boot and chain of trust, signed software and updates, key management and factory provisioning, protection of debug and physical interfaces, data protection, and regulatory cybersecurity requirements such as EU RED

### **Within the first year:**

* Lead the embedded software architecture for the next generation sensor, covering OS, bootloader, update mechanism, and security, and document the decisions for the wider team
* Establish a repeatable workflow with Data Science and Computer Vision for moving models and algorithms onto the device
* Grow the team’s embedded Linux depth through design reviews, code review, and coaching, so kernel and driver work no longer depends on one person

**How to succeed in this role**
-------------------------------

### **Key Competencies**

* **Critical Thinking:** Develop frameworks for solving complex embedded problems, from kernel behavior to hardware interactions. Mentor teammates in structured debugging and root cause analysis.
* **Delivering Innovative Solutions:** Develop strategies for the device software platform, including the next generation, and guide the team in executing them.
* **Empowering Others:** Coach engineers on Linux and software practices while learning about LineVision’s hardware from teammates. Drive initiatives that develop the team.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Develop approaches for working with Data Science, Computer Vision, and hardware teams. Influence decisions on what runs where on the device.

### **Essential Skills**

* Linux kernel and device driver development in C, including device trees and common bus and camera interfaces
* Bootloader development (U-Boot or similar) and board bring-up of new SoCs or modules
* Embedded Linux security patching and maintenance over a multi-year product life, including CVE triage and kernel upgrades
* A software engineering background with strong working knowledge of hardware: reading schematics and datasheets, debugging with JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers
* Scripting in Python and Bash
* A track record of technical leadership: setting direction for a platform or subsystem and raising the bar for the engineers around you

### **What Sets the Best Candidates Apart**

* Hardware-level device security experience, including secure boot, chain of trust, key management, and secure factory provisioning
* Experience optimizing embedded Linux for boot time, power, and reliability
* Experience running workloads on NPU

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**About the Role**
------------------

Community Intelligence is a new engineering team at OpenGov, based in our Boston office, chartered with bringing next-generation physical-world sensing and AI-based detection into our Community Operations suite. Rather than treating sensing as an external add-on, this team builds the pipeline and integration layer that make it a native, foundational capability across our products.

As a founding Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will design and build the systems that turn raw sensor data into structured records, condition assessments, and automated workflows across multiple products. You will make real technical calls with incomplete information, evaluating emerging sensing technologies, reconciling third-party data against our own systems, and sequencing a rollout across a multi-product suite. You will also set patterns the rest of the team builds on. AI-native tooling is expected to be embedded in your workflow.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Design and build the sensing-platform connector/adapter layer that maps LiDAR- and imagery-derived asset detections into OpenGov Products
* Architect the automated detection-to-case pipeline that turns a sensing detection into a properly routed record in the right product's workflow engine, complete with photo evidence, GPS coordinates, and a severity score.
* Evaluate, integrate, or build the computer-vision and LiDAR-fusion models this requires, including the technical path for consolidating with or extending EAM's existing Vision AI microservice (rd-capture).
* Design the data model and storage layer for a continuously updated spatial data that all five Community Operations products read from and contribute to.
* Own the technical design for a tiered sensing-ingestion model (satellite, fleet-vehicle camera, full LiDAR survey) supporting different refresh cadences, accuracy levels, and price points.
* Partner with engineering and product leads across OpenGov products to sequence the sensing layer's roadmap against each product's asset taxonomy and compliance requirements.
* Write clear technical design docs that AI tooling can execute against; review and own AI-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit.
* Establish testing, monitoring, and data-quality standards appropriate to a system whose outputs feed regulatory and safety-relevant workflows, including ADA compliance and FEMA reimbursement documentation.

**Qualifications & Preferred Experience**
-----------------------------------------

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex, cross-system integrations end-to-end in a production SaaS environment.
* Experience building or integrating computer-vision, LiDAR, or geospatial data-processing pipelines; comfort with point-cloud or 3D spatial data is a strong plus.
* Strong data-modeling and API/connector design skills, able to reconcile a third party's data schema against multiple existing internal data models without resorting to one-off custom logic.
* Experience with geospatial systems (PostGIS, spatial indexing, coordinate reference systems) preferred.
* Comfortable operating with incomplete information and ambiguous vendor integration paths; makes and defends build-vs-integrate calls.
* Experience partnering across multiple product teams and translating a strategic technical vision into a scoped, sequenced delivery plan.
* A track record of shipping systems where data accuracy carries real compliance or safety consequences (regulatory, infrastructure, or public-sector systems) is a strong plus.
* Proficient in AI-native engineering workflows: can direct AI tooling for scaffolding, test generation, and code review while retaining ownership of architecture and correctness.
* Excellent written communication; can produce technical design docs that align stakeholders across five product teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**How This Level Is Differentiated**
------------------------------------

The following competency behaviors distinguish this level from adjacent ones:

jobs.title: RF Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**About VectorWave**

VectorWave is building the Analog Processing Unit (APU), the world’s first programmable neuromorphic processor that runs AI inference on raw radio-frequency waveforms pre-digitization. Conventional RF systems must digitize the signal before any AI inference can occur, fundamentally limiting the latency, power consumption, and performance of wireless edge compute. The APU bypasses these bottlenecks by performing the AI signal processing fully in analog.

We are a venture-backed MIT spinout translating award-winning research into new wireless products with fundamentally new capabilities. With applications spanning defense (electronic warfare, spectrum awareness, anti-jam) and commercial wireless (Wi-Fi and 5G/6G spectrum sharing, interference management), we are building a team of engineers who are excited to transform the future of wireless communications!

**The role**

The RF embedded firmware engineer role entails designing and developing the programmable systems for VectorWave’s APU. In a multi-disciplinary effort, you will work closely with the analog hardware RF engineers and RF machine learning engineers to create subsystems that enable the APU to execute programmable signal processing operations and AI functionalities for wireless edge compute. Your work will be integrated with that of the other subsystem designers to advance the APU.

**Location:** This is an in-person, full-time role at our office in the Greater Boston area. There may occasionally be some travel to conferences.

**What you'll do**

* Design subsystems for the APU’s programmable edge compute
* Choose the components and design circuit systems integrating RF components, memory, and microprocessors
* Program the control scheme and interface for the programmable APU subsystem
* Evaluate the performance of the programmable APU subsystem against internal and customer KPIs
* Work with the RF, machine learning, and system engineers to ensure inter-system compatibility

**What you bring**

* Expertise programming and interfacing with ADCs, DACs, and on-board memory
* Experience programming microprocessor units (MPUs) and/or RF system-on-chips (SoCs) and/or edge FPGAs
* Experience designing and implementing system-level interfaces between components
* Mathematical maturity and mastery of the physics of designed circuits
* Experience designing and implementing methods of analog system characterization
* Experience implementing environmental hardware stabilization as necessary
* A BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related field

**Nice to have**

* An MS or PhD in a relevant field
* Published experimental demonstrations of any scalable analog circuitry (e.g. AI hardware accelerators, photonic integrated circuits, quantum hardware)
* Development board design experience
* Robust system documentation experience
* Experience using RF signal processing devices & components
* In-situ/physics-aware/back propagation-free machine learning for AI hardware accelerators
* Experience developing physically accurate digital twins to validate hardware designs through math and simulation
* Understanding of RF signal processing techniques
* RF PCB design & impedance matching experience

**How we work**

* **Always be curious.** Sometimes the most profound outcomes come from paying attention to the smallest details.
* **Truth guides us.** Honesty and candor are foundational. Don't delay hard conversations, start them.
* **Think out loud.** Voicing anything both technical and non-technical helps us solve problems together.
* **Mistakes are expected.** Perfection is impossible when you're building something new. We want to navigate challenges thoughtfully so we can learn and improve.
* **Adaptability is essential.** Make the best decision with the information at hand, then be ready to adjust.
* **Lean on each other.** As we scale, we aim to maintain our scrappy, small team camaraderie.

**Compensation and benefits**

Competitive salary and meaningful equity, plus:

**The basics**

* Medical: UnitedHealthcare Choice Plus, platinum tier. $10 primary care visit. $10 therapy visits.
* Dental: Blue Cross Blue Shield Dental Blue. Child orthodontia included.
* Vision: Guardian.
* Unlimited PTO.

**Family matters**

* We offer 95% dependent premium coverage.
* Plus, we have uncapped IVF support for fertility and family planning.
* Coming soon: Twenty-six weeks of parental leave at 100% of pay for every parent: birthing, non-birthing, adoptive, and foster.

**For life beyond work**

* 401(k): we match 100% of the first 6% of pay, dollar for dollar.
* Take care of yourself with a $2,000 annual wellness benefit.

**Equal opportunity**

VectorWave is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know.

Oracle is seeking a Senior Power Engineer to join the team that designs and supports power solutions for its server architectures. The role spans the full product lifecycle, from concept and prototyping through qualification, production, and sustaining engineering. Key products include AC/DC power supplies, battery backup units (BBUs), BBU shelves, and rack-mounted power distribution units (PDUs), with particular emphasis on ORv3-based systems.

The engineer will design and integrate electrical subsystems that meet functional, performance, efficiency, security, and reliability requirements. Responsibilities include component selection and qualification, schematic capture, FPGA design where applicable, and the testing and validation of analog and digital power-control systems. The role also involves developing specifications, test plans, test reports, signal integrity constraints, and bills of materials; investigating product issues; and working across engineering teams to bring designs into production and support them over time.

The successful candidate will bring deep experience in power electronics, strong knowledge of analog and digital power control, clear technical communication skills, and familiarity with relevant industry standards, tools, and design practices.

The role will be based in Burlington Massachusetts and is not a remote position.

  

**Key Responsibilities — Senior Power Engineer**

* Lead the design, development, and integration of power supplies, converters, battery backup units (BBUs), BBU shelves, and power distribution units (PDUs) for Oracle server and rack-level systems. Translate system requirements into designs that meet performance, efficiency, reliability, cost, and schedule targets.
* Bring up prototypes and lead hands-on lab characterization, testing, and debugging across operating loads and environmental conditions.
* Develop test plans and validation methods to confirm that power products operate reliably and integrate correctly with Oracle server architectures. Build and maintain validation automation where appropriate.
* Partner with firmware, software, diagnostics, and system engineering teams to implement power controls, monitoring, fault reporting, and system-level diagnostics.
* Work with component suppliers and power-product vendors to define requirements, verify performance, resolve technical issues, and qualify designs and alternate sources.
* Lead sustaining engineering investigations, including customer escalations, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and component end-of-life issues.
* Prepare specifications, lead design reviews and communicate technical trade-offs and results to cross-functional teams.
* Apply relevant power-conversion, safety, EMC, and environmental standards throughout development. Lead pre-compliance activities and coordinate with test teams and external laboratories to support global certifications.
* Mentor junior engineers and identify design, test, and process improvements for future power products.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering with at least 10 years of power electronics experience, or a master’s degree in Electrical Engineering with at least 7 years of experience.
* Strong understanding of switch-mode power supplies and rack-level battery backup systems.
* Experience with I²C and PMBus communications, and analog and digital PWM control architectures.
* Proficiency with power electronics lab equipment, including bench power supplies, AC sources, oscilloscopes, current probes, and high-voltage probes.
* Working knowledge of C++ and Python.
* Familiarity with applicable safety standards and global compliance requirements. Basic knowledge of network communications is a plus.

**Soft Skills and Leadership**

* Communicates technical findings and decisions clearly with engineers, stakeholders, vendors, and leadership.
* Uses sound analytical judgment to investigate complex problems, document findings, recommend solutions, and escalate critical issues when needed.
* Works independently while collaborating across teams, listening to different perspectives, and aligning solutions with product and customer needs.

jobs.description:
We are seeking an Electrical Engineer to work closely with our mechanical engineering and manufacturing teams to support the design, documentation, assembly, and continuous improvement of our electron beam equipment. This role is ideal for an early-career engineer looking to develop hands-on experience in industrial electrical systems, controls, and machine design while receiving mentorship from senior engineering staff.

The successful candidate will assist in developing electrical schematics and wire run lists, helping to standardize electrical designs for future machine offerings. They will also support the creation of manufacturing work instructions and documentation to ensure efficient wiring and assembly processes. While travel is not expected as part of the role, opportunities for domestic and international travel to customer sites may arise to support installations, troubleshooting, or technical projects.

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

* Assist with the design, documentation, and implementation of electrical control systems under the guidance of senior engineering staff.
* Support the development and standardization of electrical schematics and wire run lists using AutoCAD Electrical.
* Work closely with the mechanical engineering team to ensure seamless integration of electrical and mechanical systems.
* Collaborate with manufacturing to provide technical support during machine wiring, assembly, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Support the development and maintenance of manufacturing SOPs, work instructions, and electrical documentation.
* Assist in evaluating existing electrical controls and wiring methods for opportunities to improve reliability, manufacturability, and performance.
* Help ensure engineering documentation released to manufacturing is complete, accurate, and up to date.
* Assist with migrating engineering documentation into the Autodesk Vault document management system.
* Support third-party controls consultants, including Opto22 programming efforts, to improve machine functionality and diagnostics.
* Assist with the evaluation and implementation of PLC hardware and electrical components for future machine designs.
* Perform electrical testing and validation using common test equipment, including oscilloscopes, multimeters, and waveform/function generators.

**Required Skills & Abilities**

* Basic understanding of electrical control systems and industrial wiring practices.
* Familiarity with AutoCAD Electrical or similar electrical CAD software.
* Experience using electrical test equipment, including waveform/function generators, oscilloscopes, and digital multimeters.
* Knowledge of PLC hardware and industrial controls is preferred.
* Exposure to MRP/ERP systems is a plus.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with engineering and manufacturing teams.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and develop professionally under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Opto22 programming experience is a plus but not required.
* Allen Bradley programming experience is a plus but not required.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* 3-5 years of electrical engineering experience
* Experience with AutoCAD Electrical is preferred.
* Exposure to industrial automation, machine controls, or manufacturing environments is preferred.
* Experience with electrical testing equipment, including waveform/function generators, is preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Ability to work in manufacturing and production environments as needed.
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds occasionally.

jobs.title: Principal Power Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview:**

Draper is an independent, nonprofit research and development company headquartered in Cambridge, MA. The 2,000+ employees of Draper tackle important national challenges with a promise of delivering successful and usable solutions. From military defense and space exploration to biomedical engineering, lives often depend on the solutions we provide. Our multidisciplinary teams of engineers and scientists work in a collaborative environment that inspires the cross-fertilization of ideas necessary for true innovation. For more information about Draper, visit www.draper.com.

**Job Description Summary:**

A Principal Precision Analog/Power Electronics Engineer designs, specifies, develops, and tests analog/ power electronics for a wide array of applications, such as switched-mode power conversion, battery management circuitry, distributed power architectures, wireless power transfer, radiation hardened designs, motor controllers, low noise power conditioning for precision instrumentation, analog front ends, signal conditioning, analog-to-digital conversion, precision feedback systems, and dc/dc conversion. The engineer develops the architecture, designs these circuits, performs simulations, implements the physical layout, verifies and tests designs. They also perform a variety of engineering activities throughout the life cycle to support planning, design, test, deployment, and sustainment.

**Job Description:**

**Duties/Responsibilities**

* Designs new products and develops technical specifications for their production.
* Analyzes hardware configuration and processing solutions and tests hardware conformance to specifications.
* Independently drives solutions to complex problems - develops requirements, proposes ways forward when customer requirements are unclear or incomplete, and adapts appropriately to changes in requirements.
* Subject Matter Expert (SME) able to develop advanced architectures and designs for complex electronics.
* Supports business development activities including leading the development of proposals and engaging with sponsors.
* Identifies program/system-level technical risks and develops and executes mitigation strategies.
* Ability to manage multi-disciplinary tasks with cross functional teams and effectively communicates status to project leadership and customers.
* Develops, documents, and teaches best practices to less experienced teammates; Demonstrates strong organization, planning, and time management skills to achieve program goals.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Skills/Abilities**

* Proficient with schematic capture and printed circuit board layout.
* Ability to perform circuit simulation using Spice or other simulation tools.
* System modeling and analysis experience using MATLAB, Simulink, or other comparable tools.
* Ability to prioritize tasks
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent time management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Eager to learn new technical skills and expand their depth/technical knowledge.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field required. Advanced degree preferred.

10+ years of experience in electrical engineering or related field.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**General Responsibilities:**

The Software Design Engineer is primarily responsible for developing software component design specifications, based on the software architecture design specification. The software component design specifications are the deliverable to the software coders, so they are very detailed - specifying the static structure and the dynamic behavior of the software component.

The engineer will monitor the work of the software coders and testers, providing direction and clarification as needed, and work on the code themselves. Participate and occasionally lead code reviews, unit test reviews, and functional/integration test reviews.

The engineer will follow the lead of a Software Architect, and may support the architect in parsing customer requirements, developing sub-sections of a software requirements specification or developing sub-sections of a software architecture specification.

**Job Responsibilities:**

Includes the following (other duties may be documented and assigned by local management and some duties may not apply dependent upon the requirements of the position at each specific Astemo site and/or the strengths of the employee and the needs of the company):

* Develop software component design specifications
* Develop software unit test specifications
* Attend, and potentially lead, software design reviews
* Conduct technical impact analysis for software change requests
* Identify technical risks in the design, and develop mitigation strategies
* Assist software coders work progress; develop source code as necessary to maintain program timelines
* Participate or lead code reviews, unit test reviews, and integration test reviews
* Support development of software requirements specification (SRS) and software architecture specification sub-sections, if needed by the software architect
* Support development of integration test specification sub-sections, if needed by the software architect
* Support source code integration, diff, merge, branching, check-in, etc., if needed by the software coders
* Support unit test and integration test execution, if needed by the software testers

**Qualifications:**

* 5+ years' experience in writing embedded software in C with knowledge of Eclipse IDE or similar preferred
* **Microcontrollers.** 32-bit automotive multi-core micros. Renesas E2x/RH850 family; Infineon Aurix TCxx family; NXP MPC55xx family.
* **Microcontroller Hardware.** Timers (GTM,TPU,WDT), Memory (RAM, FLASH, ECC, DMA), Peripherals (ADC,PWM,GPIO,CAN,SENT,UART,LIN,SPI), Safety (SMU, FCCU), etc.
* **Hardware IC Devices.** High side drivers, low side drivers, H-Bridge, injection drivers, knock drivers, solenoid drivers, WRAF drivers, CAN Transceivers, etc.
* **Software Design Tools.** Requirements modeling, UML modeling, AUTOSAR configuration, RTOS configuration, Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).
* **Software Development Tools.** Cross compilers, static code analysis, in-circuit debuggers, serial communication tools, HIL systems, measurement & calibration tools.
* **Test Equipment.** Oscilloscope, multimeter, logic analyzer, current probes, function generator, etc.
* **Software Process/Standards.** V-Model, MISRA, ASPICE, ISO26262
* **Communication Protocols.** CAN, CANFD, LIN, SENT, Ethernet. UDS, GMLAN, FNOS, J1939, IEEE15765.
* **Application Domains.** Powertrain, Automatic Transmission Controls, Gasoline Engine Control, Diesel Engine Control, Basic Software (BSW)
* **Software Architecture.** Basic Software, Low Level Drivers, Board Support Package, Boot Code, BIOS, MCAL
* Familiar with crypto algorithms, and cryptographic authentication method
* Ability to read schematics, electrical block diagrams, and IC datasheets
* Good verbal and written English skills

Additionally, the ability to work independently with minimal direction is required as are strong verbal and written communication skills. Experience with PCs and application software, such as MS Office tools is also required.

**Education:** Bachelor or Master’s degree in in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering

**Experience:** Minimum of 5-7 years applicable experience in automotive.

Job level determined by various factors such as organization size, responsibility, career stage, and capabilities.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:** leading and mentoring the efforts of engineers who are responsible for sub-project activities.

**Working conditions:**

* **Physical Demands:** Required to sit or stand for long periods of time. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

* **Travel:** Domestic and international may be required as needed. The candidate will occasionally need to travel to multiple global locations to support project development.

jobs.title: Controls Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

The Controls Engineering Manager is responsible for the overall operational, technical, and strategic leadership of the Controls Engineering Department. This position directs the development of electrical schematics, control panel designs, PLC/HMI software development, robotics, machine vision, and commissioning for custom automated assembly systems.

This role provides technical governance, resource planning, and team mentorship. The ideal candidate brings extensive background in custom assembly automation, mastery of Allen-Bradley architectures, direct integration experience with Fanuc robotics and industrial vision systems, and the ability to drive customer design reviews and project schedules.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Department Leadership & Operational Execution**

* **Resource Allocation & Scheduling:** Direct daily operations of the controls engineering team. Plan, schedule, and balance engineering hours across active build cycles (schematic design, panel build support, programming, shop-floor debug, and runoff).

* **Team Development & Mentorship:** Supervise, evaluate, and mentor controls engineers and programmers. Serve as the primary technical sounding board and escalation point to unblock team members during machine debug.

* **Standardization & Best Practices:** Develop, implement, and maintain departmental standards for 2D AutoCAD drafting (symbol blocks, drawing templates, layer structures) and Rockwell/Fanuc/vision programming architectures.

* **Process Improvement:** Identify and resolve workflow bottlenecks between electrical design, mechanical engineering, panel build, and shop-floor assembly.

**2. Technical Governance & Integration Oversight**

* **Schematic & Design Approval:** Review and sign off on all multi-sheet electrical, pneumatic, and safety circuit drawing packages generated in standard 2D AutoCAD. Ensure accurate manual cross-referencing, proper wire/device labeling, and rigorous BOM generation.

* **Core Automation Platforms:** Govern all software development within the **Rockwell / Allen-Bradley** environment (Studio 5000, ControlLogix, GuardLogix safety routines, FactoryTalk View ME/SE, EtherNet/IP, and Kinetix motion).

* **Robotics & Machine Vision:** Oversee the integration, programming standards, and troubleshooting of **Fanuc robotics** (handling/assembly applications) and machine vision systems (**Keyence** and **Cognex** inspection, guidance, and identification systems).

* **Regulatory Compliance:** Ensure all machine wiring, control panels, and safety interlocks strictly comply with NFPA 79, NFPA 70 (NEC), and UL 508A requirements.

**3. Commercial Alignment & Customer Interfacing**

* **Customer Design Reviews:** Lead customer controls design reviews, establishing technical authority and securing formal sign-offs on drawings, safety concepts, and sequences of operation.

* **Scope & Change-Order Management:** Defend project scope against creep. Identify, document, and price out-of-scope customer requests to ensure engineering change orders are executed.

* **Quoting & Estimation Support:** Review customer RFQs and specifications to develop accurate controls engineering hours, hardware component costs, cycle-time feasibility assessments, and technical risk evaluations.

Join us as a Controls Manager to help shape a resilient financial environment built on transparency, compliance, and operational excellence!

Pay: From $90,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Location:** United States - Minneapolis, MN

**Pay:** $97,500 - $150,600

  

With more than $1B in revenue, Tennant Company is a globally recognized leader in the cleaning equipment industry. For the past 150 years, we have been passionate about developing and manufacturing innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers. At Tennant Company, we are committed to stewardship and creating a cleaner, safer and healthier world. With manufacturing, operations and sales, service, and support functions across the globe, your journey at Tennant can take you places you never expected.

  

We are seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to join the Tennant Company (TNC) Robotics Product Development organization. This role combines strong hands-on systems engineering execution with emerging technical leadership responsibilities, supporting the definition, integration, and delivery of complex electro-mechanical, electrical, and software-enabled robotic systems.

  

The Senior Systems Engineer contributes to system-level design and integration while owning key subsystems or technical areas end-to-end. This role partners closely with Electrical, Software, Mechanical, and Manufacturing teams to translate product and business requirements into well-defined, verifiable system solutions, while beginning to influence architectural direction, technical decisions, and engineering best practices.

Success is measured by technical quality, execution reliability, system integration effectiveness, and the ability to guide work, reduce risk, and elevate team performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

Systems Engineering & Emerging Architecture Ownership

* Own development and delivery of subsystem architectures and system features, ensuring alignment with overall system design.
* Lead requirements decomposition, allocation, and verification for assigned systems and subsystems.
* Establish functional requirements and performance targets for electrical and control subsystems, including power, communications, and safety.
* Create and maintain system documentation including requirements, interface definitions, and verification artifacts.
* Contribute to system-level architecture discussions, providing technical input on tradeoffs, scalability, and maintainability.
Utilize requirements and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Jama, Visure, or similar.  

Electrical Integration & Controls Engineering

* Lead integration of electrical subsystems, including:
* Wiring harnesses, connectors, and cable routing
* Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBAs)
* Controllers and embedded software interfaces
* Power distribution and protection (fuses, circuit breakers)
* Contribute to definition and implementation of machine control systems, including closed-loop control strategies.
* Support and guide integration of communication interfaces such as CAN, RS-232, Ethernet, and USB.
Troubleshoot complex electrical and controls issues across development, validation, and production environments.  

Verification, Testing & Technical Rigor

* Define and execute verification strategies for assigned systems to ensure requirements traceability and performance.
* Apply design risk assessment tools such as DFMEA and HARA to identify and mitigate system-level risks.
* Support and influence compliance activities, including UL, IEC, EMC, and related standards.
* Utilize modeling or analysis tools (e.g., MATLAB, Simulink, MathCad, PSpice) as appropriate to validate system behavior.
Drive structured root cause analysis and resolution of integration issues.  

Execution, Prototyping & Product Development

* Own delivery of complex subsystems or integration workstreams within New Product Development (NPD).
* Lead and execute Proofs of Concept (POCs) and prototype builds to validate design assumptions and de-risk development.
* Break down technical challenges into structured tasks and milestones with clear outcomes.
* Actively lead or contribute to design reviews with a strong system-level perspective.
Support product launches by ensuring designs are robust, manufacturable, and serviceable.  

Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Provide technical guidance and informal mentorship to junior engineers.
* Drive alignment across teams on system interfaces, integration strategies, and technical decisions.
* Collaborate closely with Systems, Electrical, Software, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and external partners.
* Communicate technical concepts, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders at multiple levels.
* Influence best practices in requirements management, integration, and system validation.
  

**Education & Experience**

Required

* Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 5+ years of experience in systems engineering, electrical engineering, or controls-focused roles.
* Strong hands-on experience in electrical system integration and testing for complex products.
* Experience owning subsystems or significant technical workstreams.
* Experience with requirements development, decomposition, verification, and technical documentation.
Proven experience working on cross-functional engineering teams.  

Preferred

* Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, or complex electro-mechanical products.
* Experience with batteries, chargers, power electronics, or control systems.
* Familiarity with model-based design and simulation tools (MATLAB/Simulink, PSpice, MathCad).
* Experience with an object-oriented programming language (C#, Python, or C++).
* Exposure to production support, manufacturing ramp-up, or end-of-line testing.
* Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., code generation, test automation, requirements management, or data analytics) to accelerate development.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. jobs.title: Senior Autonomous Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At the interface of design, engineering and supply logistics, REHAU Automotive and SRG Global combine to form RESRG - a leading global supplier of coated exterior systems and components. With a combined track record of over 160 years across four continents and 22 production sites, RESRG's 10,000 skilled team members manufacture the latest exterior systems and components for the world's leading automotive manufacturers.
  
  
We are looking for you to join our team as Senior Autonomous Systems Engineer at our Portageville, Missouri facility!
  
  
Your Job
  
You will help transform our Portageville operation into one of the most advanced manufacturing facilities in North America.
  
This is an opportunity to design the future state of manufacturing from the ground up by developing factory layouts, optimizing material flow, deploying advanced simulation tools, and creating the infrastructure required to support our Overall Automation Maturity Index (OAMI) strategy and Lights-Out Manufacturing roadmap. You will work at the intersection of manufacturing, automation, robotics, logistics, and digital engineering to create highly efficient production systems that maximize productivity, minimize waste, and support autonomous operations.
  
If you enjoy solving complex operational challenges, visualizing the factory before it is built, and creating innovative solutions that redefine manufacturing performance, this role was built for you.
  
  
What You Will Do in Your Role
  

* Develop and optimize plant, department, and production layouts using AutoCAD and advanced 3D modeling tools.
* Create digital factory models and simulations to validate future manufacturing concepts before implementation.
* Design material handling routes that maximize efficiency while supporting robotic, AGV, and AMR operations.
* Analyze and optimize product flow, inventory flow, and information flow throughout the facility.
* Lead value stream mapping and factory optimization initiatives to reduce waste and improve productivity.
* Support the deployment of advanced automation systems by ensuring proper equipment placement, flow paths, and operational integration.
* Develop capacity models and scenario analysis to support growth, expansion, and future-state planning.
* Partner with robotics, controls, manufacturing, quality, maintenance, and operations teams to execute transformation projects.
* Utilize simulation and modeling software to evaluate throughput, bottlenecks, labor utilization, and system performance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that advance OAMI maturity and support increasing levels of autonomous manufacturing.
* Establish factory standards for layout design, material movement, storage strategies, and operational excellence.
* Support brownfield projects from concept development through implementation.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)
  

* BS/MS in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience in manufacturing, industrial engineering, or operations optimization.
* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD for facility and manufacturing layout development.
* Experience in creating detailed plant layouts, workstation designs, and facility flow plans.
* Knowledge of lean manufacturing, value stream mapping, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and project management abilities.
* Ability to visualize and design complex manufacturing systems.

What Will Put You Ahead
  

* Experience with 3D factory simulation and modeling software.
* Experience with FlexSim or similar simulation platforms.
* Knowledge of AGVs, AMRs, automated storage systems, and autonomous material handling.
* Experience developing warehouses and production material flow strategies.
* Understanding of robotic manufacturing systems and automation integration.
* Automotive manufacturing experience.
* Knowledge of Industry 4.0, digital twins, smart factories, and advanced manufacturing technologies.

Join the Team Shaping the Next Generation of Manufacturing
  
At RESRG Automotive, we are investing in technologies, people, and ideas that will define the future of manufacturing. As a Senior Autonomous Systems Engineer
  
in Portageville, you will have a unique opportunity to create the layouts, material flow strategies, simulation models, and operational systems that enable our journey toward Lights-Out Manufacturing.
  
  
About the Company
  
We are a fast-growing global manufacturer with a strong internal culture that values respect, diversity, and purposeful work. We offer career paths that enable professional growth, a team-focused environment, and a commitment to safety and wellness.
  
  
Our Benefits
  
Our goal is for each employee and their family to live fulfilling and healthy lives. Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, AD&D, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, paid parental leave, and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria are set by the applicable Summary Plan Description. Speak to your recruiter for details on benefits that apply to you.
  
  
Equal Opportunities
  
Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E-Verify.

* Conduct design reviews, internal factory acceptance testing, quality checks, customer demonstrations, and acceptance testing.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical, chemical, computer, or engineering technology, or a closely related technical field.
* Three or more years of hands-on controls engineering experience, including programming or configuration of PLC, DDC, DCS, or SCADA/HMI systems.
* Experience with at least one of the following platforms: Rockwell FactoryTalk, RSLogix/Studio 5000, or PlantPAx; AVEVA/Wonderware System Platform; Inductive Automation Ignition Perspective; or Distech BACnet/LON or ECY-Series controllers.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical work, coordinate project activities, and communicate effectively with customers and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to read and develop P&IDs, control drawings, electrical schematics, and related engineering documentation.
* Ability to work from the assigned office and travel to client sites approximately 20% to 40% of the time.

**Preferred Experience**

* Leadership of small engineering teams, customer meetings, FAT/SAT activities, startup, or commissioning.

**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

**What We’re Doing**  
  
At Lockheed Martin, our team at the Mount Laurel, NJ site supports the SEMS (Systems Engineering, Modeling & Simulation) Ship Integration Engineering organization. We design, develop, and maintain advanced combat system cabling solutions that enable seamless integration of mission-critical naval and land-based systems. Our work ensures reliable connectivity, interoperability, and performance across complex platforms supporting the U.S. Navy and allied forces.  
  
**The Work**  
  
Generate and maintain Combat System Cable Block Diagrams (CBD) and Cable Installation / Interconnection Drawings (CIID), including:  
  
Cable Running Sheets (CRS), Minimum Data Sets (MDS), Cable Impact Statements (CIS), Network Maintenance Diagrams (NMD), and Electrical Interface Control Drawings (EICD).  
  
Serve as the responsible engineer for the development of cable products and associated deliverables within the SEMS Ship Integration Engineering team.  
  
Review PARM, OEM, and vendor Installation Control Drawings and Technical Data Package (TDP) products for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with program requirements.  
  
Provide engineering support across multiple ship classes and land-based test sites.  
  
Conduct ship checks to assess existing conditions and deliver on-site engineering support during installation and testing of new equipment and systems.  
  
Lead peer engineers and engineering aides, ensuring customer requirements and project schedules remain the top priority.  
  
Please note:
  
  
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD clearance at the Secret level.
  
  
This position is fulltime onsite in Mount Laurel, NJ.  
  
This position requires the ability to travel up to 5%.
  
  
**Who We Are**  
  
We are part of Lockheed Martin’s SEMS Ship Integration Engineering organization based in Mount Laurel, NJ. Our team specializes in integrating complex combat systems, ensuring that hardware, software, and cabling architectures function as a cohesive, mission-ready solution. We value technical excellence, collaboration, and a strong commitment to supporting national defense.  
  
**Who You Are**  
  
You are a detail-driven engineer with experience in cable systems, electrical integration, or related disciplines. You thrive in a collaborative environment, can lead technical efforts, and are comfortable working both in office settings and on-site at shipyards or test facilities. You are committed to quality, mentorship, and delivering on customer expectations in a fast-paced, mission-focused organization.  
  
**Why Join Us**  
  
Joining Lockheed Martin in Mount Laurel, NJ means becoming part of a world-class engineering organization at the forefront of naval combat system integration. We offer opportunities for professional growth, leadership development, and meaningful work that supports those who serve.

Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, System Engineering, Engineering Technology, or Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience in a Engineering discipline with 2+ years of related professional experience.
  
  
Familiarity of various network types.
  
  
Familiarity with cable interface design.  
  
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD clearance at the Secret level.
  
  
This position is fulltime onsite in Mount Laurel, NJ.  
  
This position requires the ability to travel up to 5%.

**Desired Skills**
------------------

Systems engineering background.  
  
Knowledge of various network types, current commercial trends in this field, as well as the cabling materials required to support.  
  
Basic level of knowledge of both military and commercial electrical interface protocols, Combat System integration criteria, equipment interaction methods, major signal flows, as well as, USN and commercial Shipbuilding Specifications.  
  
Basic level of understanding of the AEGIS Combat System program philosophies including the Shipbuilders’ role, the role of the major equipment vendors of the ACS, and the role of the Land Sites as Development, Test, Acceptance, Production, and Training facilities for AEGIS.

Compliance, Telemetry & Reporting

Leadership

----------------

  

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

* Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
* Extraordinary co-workers
* Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
* Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
* Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance\*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov

  

* These benefits vary by job classification.

**What Your Job Will Be Like**
------------------------------

  

We are seeking highly motivated electrical engineer to join our dynamic team. Our organization is a research and development team responsible for embedded electronics, electrical and RF technologies from design to production for a wide variety of Transportation Safety and Security Programs (TSSP). The ideal candidate possesses a strong background in electronics or electrical engineering principles, design, development, prototyping, and implementation. He or she will be a part of team that designs, builds, tests, integrates in a challenging fast-paced environment. These roles offer exciting opportunities to work on innovative projects and contribute to cutting-edge technologies.

On any given day, you may be called on to:

* Assist in the design, development, and testing of electronic circuits, custom PCBAs, and integrated systems under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Support the creation and review of schematics, layouts, programming and design documentation to ensure accuracy and compliance with requirements.
* Participate in hardware testing activities including functional verification, signal integrity checks, environmental testing, and necessary software code.
* Help implement design for test (DFT) and design for manufacturability (DFM) principles to improve design quality.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support hardware-software integration and system optimization.
* Assist in troubleshooting and resolving manufacturing and product performance issues.
* Learn and apply failure mode effects analysis (FMEA) and fault tree analysis techniques to identify potential design risks.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies in electronics and electrical systems through training and research.
* Contribute technical support to project teams working on transportation and other advanced technology initiatives.

Due to the nature of the work the selected applicant must work onsite.

**Salary Range**
----------------

  

$102,400 - $199,700

* Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

**Qualifications We Require**
-----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development.
* Ability to obtain a DOE Q clearance.

**Qualifications We Desire**
----------------------------

  

The ideal R&D S&E Electrical Engineering candidate for Sandia National Laboratories will in addition possess the following:

* Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science/Engineering or a highly related field where an independent research project was a graduation requirement (e.g., independent project, thesis, or dissertation).
* Ability to work and collaborate well in a multidisciplinary team of design and test engineers.
Outstanding verbal and written skills, including the ability to develop and present briefings that are clear and compelling  

Also, for this posting we are seeking individuals with the following experience:

* Foundational knowledge and some hands-on experience in electronic hardware design and testing, including PCB schematic capture and layout for embedded systems and microcontrollers.
* Familiarity with common communication protocols such as CAN, SPI, I2C etc.
* Experience or coursework using industry-standard PCB design and simulation tools (e.g, Siemens Xpedition or similar).

jobs.description:
Job Description & Responsibilities:

Design the circuit boards that go inside radios operators trust with their lives

At Persistent Systems, our Wave Relay® MANET technology keeps warfighters, first responders, and critical missions connected in the most contested environments on earth. We're looking for a Hardware Engineer with deep experience in battery-powered, high-speed (GHz) digital circuit design. This role is for someone who wants their boards to end up in the field, not in a reference kit.

You'll design, develop, and prototype the electronic assemblies inside our next-generation radios and the upgrades to our current products. Your work spans concept through DVT, and into direct technical support for manufacturing. This lead engineer will set design direction across a project or small set of related projects and serve as a technical resource for others.

**What you'll work on**

* Defining system- and circuit-level requirements for next-generation radio products
* Designing circuits, running analysis and simulations, and producing schematics and BOMs
* Identifying all components and equipment needed to support the product design process
* Providing PCB layout guidance and working closely with layout engineers to complete PCB designs
* Interfacing with Mechanical Engineering to meet packaging and thermal constraints
* Establishing hardware and software test environments and infrastructure
* Developing concept prototypes and running DVT to verify system performance
* Providing technical leadership for projects developed by sub-contractors
* Ensuring deliverables meet performance, cost, and reliability targets on schedule
* Providing technical support to manufacturing

**The tooling you'll work with**

We invest in the tools that move engineers' output. You'll have day-one access to a modern hardware development environment:

* Serious lab infrastructure. Full RF and digital lab: high-bandwidth scopes, spectrum and vector network analyzers, thermal chambers, and the fixtures to characterize what you build.
* Direct hand-off to manufacturing. In-house manufacturing support, so the feedback loop from board bring-up to production issues is fast.

**Why hardware engineers choose Persistent Systems**

* You own boards from end-to-end. Concept, schematic, layout guidance, bring-up, DVT, and production support, one engineer, one board, real accountability.
* Independent, not a subsidiary. Product direction gets made by the people building the radios, not filtered through a Fortune 500 parent's roadmap review.
* Mission you can point to. Our radios are deployed with U.S. and allied forces, federal agencies, and public safety teams worldwide.

**Position Responsibilities**

* Architect hardware subsystems spanning multiple products
* Promote technical standards and best practices for the hardware team
* Resolve complex technical challenges across projects
* Partner with product management and adjacent engineering functions on tradeoffs
* Mentor other engineers and contribute to hiring decisions

Job Qualifications & Experience :

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10-15 years of hardware engineering experience
* Demonstrated ownership of a complex, cross-functional hardware project
* Strong expertise in a core hardware domain (e.g. power, high-speed digital, mixed-signal)
* Developing track record of technical leadership without formal management authority
* Excellent cross-functional communication skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of audio/video encoder/decoders and interfaces
* Exposure to Embedded Firmware Development in Assembly, C and/or C++
* Experience in electromagnetic capability (EMC) testing and design
* Knowledge of 802.11 standard and system implementation
* Familiar with switching mode power supply design
* Knowledge of military qualification testing
* Modeling/simulation/development in VHDL
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent task management skills
* Experience with compliance/certification processes
* Demonstrated ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously

The compensation for this role can vary from $189,000 to $200,000 a year based on the selected individual's education and experience. Persistent Systems, LLC offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; paid time off; flexible spending accounts; 401(k) plan with company match; fitness membership reimbursement; tuition assistance; mental health benefits; and veterinary benefits. We will accept applications on a rolling basis until the role is filled.

Company Overview :

Headquartered in New York City since 2007, Persistent Systems, LLC is a global communications technology company which develops, manufactures, and integrates a patented and secure Mobile Ad Hoc Networking (MANET) system: Wave Relay®. The company’s industry leading R&D team has designed wireless networking protocols to support their cutting-edge Wave Relay® system and technology. Wave Relay® is capable of running data, video, voice and other applications under the most difficult and unpredictable conditions. Their suite of products is field proven and utilized in Commercial, Military, Government, Industrial, Agriculture, Robotics, and Unmanned System markets.

jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

**What We’re Doing**

At Lockheed Martin Rotary Mission Systems, we develop advanced technologies that support critical defense and aerospace missions. Our Owego, NY engineering teams deliver innovative Digital and RF solutions designed for demanding mission environments.

**The Work**

As a Power Engineer, you'll provide vital technical support for our Digital and RF programs, focusing on unit level power systems. You'll be responsible for analyzing and troubleshooting power distribution circuits at the circuit card assembly (CCA) and unit levels. You will interpret requirements and develop pass/fail criteria to conduct root-cause analysis and recommend engineering changes. In addition, you will assist senior engineers in circuit designs. In this role you will also develop power test procedures, execute power qualification tests, and write detailed reports to show adherence to the applicable power standards (MIL-STD-704).

Please note:

This position is located Owego, NY and is fulltime onsite.

This position requires the ability to travel up to or less than 10%.

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD government clearance at the Secret level.

**Who We Are**

Rotary Mission Systems in Owego, NY develops mission-critical technologies for advanced defense systems. Our engineers work across the product lifecycle, from requirements and design through integration, qualification, and production.

**Who You Are**

You’re a power engineer who enjoys solving complex hardware challenges and turning requirements into reliable, testable designs. You bring expertise in power distribution, power conversion, circuit analysis, and hardware troubleshooting, along with strong technical communication skills and the ability to mentor others.

**Why Join Us**

Join Lockheed Martin in Owego, NY and apply your power engineering expertise to advanced Digital and RF systems. You’ll solve challenging technical problems, collaborate with experienced engineers, and influence designs from requirements through qualification while supporting technologies built for critical missions.

------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field with 2 years related experience, or Master's degree in engineering
* Experience using component layout, board layout, and schematic capture tools
* Ability to secure a Secret clearance.

* Experience with analyzing and designing isolated and non-isolated DC/DC converters, switch-mode power supplies (SMPS), and Point-of-Load (POL) regulators
* Experience programing and utilizing programmable power supplies
* Knowledge of MIL-STD-704 and MIL-STD-461
* Knowledge of VITA specifications
* Experience with specifications writing and review, and tracking requirements through product lifecycle management tools to ensure full compliance with customer requirements
* Proficiency using oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, and benchtop power supplies and other basic lab equipment

We're looking for passionate & experienced technologists, strong communicators, and those with a commitment to continuous improvement. **THE STATS**

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. **The company built on breakthroughs.**  
**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

  

Corning’s businesses are ever-evolving to best serve our customers, industries, and consumers. Today, we accelerate and transform life sciences, mobile consumer electronics, optical communications, display, automotive, and solar markets. We are changing the world with:

* Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives
* Damage-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected
* Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light
* Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences
* Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation
* Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low-cost solar energy solutions
  

**Scope of Position:**

The Electrical Engineering Technician – Systems Test provides hands-on electrical and electromechanical support for optical assembly and test operations across both Class 100 (Molecular Cleanroom) and Class 10,000 cleanroom environments. This role is responsible for troubleshooting and resolving motor control, cabling, wiring harness, and instrumentation issues on custom metrology benches and production equipment. The technician will support daily production and test bench operations, occasionally assist with new product introduction (NPI) and new bench builds, and provide infrequent support to other departments.

  

**Day to Day Responsibilities:**

* Provide hands-on electrical technical support for daily production and test bench operations, including rapid response to motor control, cable, and wiring harness issues
* Troubleshoot and repair servo/stepper motor systems, motion controllers, encoders, and feedback devices
* Diagnose circuit-level issues on production and test equipment
* Fabricate, modify, and repair cable and wiring harness assemblies
* Perform cable testing including continuity, hi-pot, and insulation resistance verification
* Create and redline wiring diagrams, schematics, and pinout documentation
* Support new bench builds and NPI activities requiring electrical assembly, integration, and validation
* Troubleshoot data acquisition and instrumentation interfaces (GPIB, RS-232/485, USB, Ethernet/TCP-IP, EtherCAT)

**Position Overview:**

The Controls Engineer II is a mid-level engineering professional responsible for leading the design, development, implementation, and optimization of control systems for industrial automation and manufacturing processes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of hardware and software systems, troubleshooting automation issues, and ensuring system reliability, safety, and compliance with regulatory standards. The Controls Engineer II is expected to mentor junior engineers, manage automation projects, and contribute to the strategic direction of control system architecture. The role requires experience in PLC/HMI programming, motion control, robotics, and customer support. Strong project management skills, the ability to work independently, and a commitment to continuous improvement are essential for success in this role.

Responsibilities

* Develop, design and support custom control systems and automation processes
* PLC/VFD programming and troubleshooting.
* Design HMI screens for process monitoring and control.
* Integrate automation systems with other equipment, sensors, instrumentation, network communication protocols, and robotic cells.
* Perform system testing and validation to ensure all systems meet technical specifications and safety standards.
* Diagnose and resolve issues, ensuring minimal downtime and maximum productivity.
* Create and maintain detailed documentation including system schematics, BOMs, programming code, sequence of operations, and user manuals.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including mechanical engineering, assembly, inventory, and field service.
* Identify areas for improvement in existing systems and processes and recommend automation solutions to enhance efficiency, safety, and performance.
* Provide training to customers, operators and maintenance staff on system operation.
* Interface directly with customers to provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s or associate’s degree in electrical engineering or relative experience

**Experience:** 4-7 years experience in controls or automation engineering related to industrial equipment.

**Specific Skills/Requirements:**

* Proficiency with PLCs and HMIs (Allen Bradley, Siemens).
* Experience with industrial networks (Ethernet/IP, ProfiNet).
* Understanding of electrical systems, integration, and industrial automation.
* Proficiency with servo and VFD motor control, sensors, and instrumentation.
* Electrical schematic design and panel layout experience (AutoCAD Electrical).
* Understanding of hydraulic, pneumatic, and mechanical systems integration.
* Familiarity with industry standards (NEC, NFPA 70, UL 508A).
* Experience in robotic programming (Fanuc).
* Understanding of intrinsically safe and explosionproof system design
* Ability to travel 10–20%, including international travel.

Join us to be part of an innovative team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of control systems engineering!

The FPGA Digital Design Engineer supports the development of field‑programmable gate array (FPGA) firmware for airborne telemetry, radio frequency (RF), secure communications, and embedded flight‑safety systems developed at L3Harris’s TRF Bristol site. This role contributes to the design, implementation, verification, and integration of advanced digital telemetry, signal processing, instrumentation, and encryption functions used in ruggedized mission‑critical embedded hardware. The position works closely with electrical, RF, systems, and software engineering teams to translate system‑level requirements into FPGA architecture and very‑high‑speed integrated circuit hardware description language (VHDL) implementations. The successful candidate will join a collaborative engineering organization focused on delivering high‑reliability solutions supporting United States and allied aerospace and defense platforms.

* Support estimation, planning, and scheduling of FPGA development activities across the full product lifecycle.
* Translate system and circuit‑card‑level requirements into FPGA requirements, specifications, and architectures.
* Implement FPGA designs in VHDL, ensuring proper synthesis, timing closure, constraint management, resource efficiency, and platform‑specific optimization.
* Verify FPGA functionality through simulation, then integrate and test designs on targeted circuit card assemblies in airborne and ruggedized environments.
* Develop digital signal processing and communication‑oriented FPGA functions such as filtering, mixing, signal conversion, encoding, and error‑correction.
* Follow, apply, and refine disciplined firmware development processes, peer reviews, and documentation practices.
* Generate clear technical documentation including design review materials, block diagrams, interface documents, and test plans and procedures.
* Collaborate closely with RF, systems, electrical, and software engineers to ensure clean digital‑to‑RF and digital‑to‑system integration.
* Prepare FPGA designs for production readiness by supporting qualification, environmental testing, and performance validation.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a United States Secret security clearance.

* Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 6 years of relevant engineering experience; or a graduate degree and a minimum of 4 years of related experience; or, in lieu of a degree, a minimum of 10 years of related engineering experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Minimum four years of experience with VHDL development, FPGA design methodologies, and FPGA toolchains.
* Experience implementing FPGA designs with demanding timing, routing, or resource constraints.
* Experience integrating FPGA designs onto circuit card assemblies and using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and signal generators.
* Experience with at least one major FPGA vendor platform such as AMD (Xilinx), Intel (Altera), or Microchip (Microsemi).
* Experience with digital circuit design, schematic generation and PWB layout.
* Experience designing FPGA‑based hardware for ruggedized airborne, secure communications, telemetry, or RF applications.
* Experience verifying FPGA implementations against MATLAB or Simulink system‑level models.
* Experience developing FPGA‑based digital signal processing (DSP) algorithms for modulation, demodulation, filtering, or signal conversion.
* Experience with multiple FPGA toolsets (Vivado, Quartus, Libero) and embedded‑system integration.
* Experience supporting qualification, environmental testing, and performance validation for high‑reliability hardware.
* Experience with secure communications or encryption‑related FPGA processing.
* Familiarity with embedded microcontrollers or mixed FPGA‑processor architectures.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Automation Engineer**
=======================

Easton, PA – Engineering Laboratory

Full-Time

Engineering – Research & Development Laboratory

No immigration sponsorship available

**About Victaulic**
-------------------

Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range of industries.

Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world’s most critical and prestigious structures.

### **An Industry Leader With a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation**

At Victaulic, we’re committed to constructing a better world for and with our people.

**Let’s Build a Better World Together.**

Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars:

* We build from within.
* We stand behind our people.
* We foster an environment for constant learning.
* We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world.

**Your Impact Starts Here**
---------------------------

We’re looking for an Automation Engineer to join our Engineering Laboratory team in Easton, PA, reporting to the Engineering Lab Technical Lead – Automation. In this role, you’ll design, build, and maintain the control, automation, and data acquisition systems used to test and evaluate components and prototypes for new product and process introductions. You’ll work closely with design engineers, operations engineers, purchasers, and other internal partners to keep projects on schedule and make sure every standard and requirement is met during prototype development. * Support hands-on testing, including installing instrumentation and data loggers, setting up fixtures, operating hydrostatic, pneumatic, cycle, flex, and fire suppression tests, and inspecting products and components against engineering specifications and drawings

**What You Bring**
