* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering preferred
* 4+ years of controls or automation experience
* Proficiency in maintaining and troubleshooting automation equipment
* PLC programming experience (ladder, structured text, function block diagram)
* Experience with motion control systems (stepper, servo, VFDs), including drive configuration, encoder feedback, and motion profiles (gearing, camming)
* Experience managing equipment projects from design through commissioning
* Proficiency in blueprint reading, shop math, and use of precision instruments
* Working knowledge of process instrumentation (sensors, transmitters, pressure, flow, and temperature devices)
* Working knowledge of piping and fluid systems (water and compressed air), including pumps, control and solenoid valves, pressure regulation and relief, and flow and pressure measurement, with the ability to read and interpret P&IDs

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Be visionary**

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

**Job Description**

**Company Overview**

Teledyne Judson Technologies (TJT) is a global leader in detectors from the Visible to Long Wave Infra-red spectrum, offering an extensive range of single element infrared detectors. Two-dimensional focal plane arrays (InGaAs, InSb, and HgCdTe) and Integrated Dewar Cooler Assemblies (IDCA) complement our detector portfolio. The high performance of our detectors makes them highly valued in both commercial markets and critical space applications.

**Position Summary**

TJT is seeking a Systems Engineer to design, develop, and characterize packages and integrated dewar cooled arrays for infrared detectors. The successful candidate will be well versed in Solidworks and Ansys, and can prepare, generate and analyze structural (including factors of safety), thermal (computational fluid dynamics), and vibrational simulations. Previous experience with photodetectors/cameras and/or in optical design/modeling is considered a plus. The candidate will generate models and technical drawings, and support part procurement, product assembly, and product test as needed. The candidate must be able to work both independently and in collaboration with a cross functional team as necessary to ensure successful development of new products.

The ideal candidate has significant experience in ultra-high vacuum processing, including but not limited to loading and unloading devices onto a vacuum manifold, getter activation and degas, pinch-off, and leak check. Experience with laser welding, and metrology is desired.

**Essential Duties and** **Responsibilities**

* Evaluates customers’ requirements and designs/specifies the detector focal plane packaging and cooling options. Applications range from commercial/industrial to high-reliability space/military
* Provides analysis related to the design, development, and implementation of parts, components, and other materials for mechanical assemblies
* Generates necessary technical content (including models, drawings, calculations and simulation results) to review customer specification and prepare charts accordingly for internal- or customer-facing technical reviews
* Prepares cost models and generates project schedules. Prepares risk analysis and generates risk matrix
* Leads other designers to detail component parts and/or assist with system development
* Performs first-order analysis of heat transfer, structural, random vibration, and fastener pre-loads
* Performs Finite Element Analysis
* Supports material selection, including but not limited to sizing of TECs, cryo-coolers, and getters
* Develops test strategies, fixtures, and tooling. Prepares test procedures and test reports as necessary to document designs, procedures, and results
* Manually calculates stress on components
* Calculates vacuum life (based on package design, component selection, free volume, and other required inputs)
* Conducts failure analyses and supports identification of failure root cause and appropriate solutions
* Follows import/export requirements, consulting with facility trade compliance personnel
* Comfortable leading a project team and work

**Qualifications & Competencies**

* M.S. or Ph. D degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field and >15 years of directly related experience and/or training (>10 years for Ph.D) in a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of demonstrated detector packaging with an emphasis on vacuum Dewar design
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to organize data and write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients and customers.
* Significant experience in high vacuum processing, including but not limited to loading and unloading devices onto a vacuum manifold, RGA analysis, getter activation and degas, pinch-off, and leak check (Helium). Experience with laser welding and metrology.
* Experience with design/modeling and simulations in Ansys and Solidworks. Familiarity with Zemax considered a plus. The candidate should also have knowledge of applicable database and ERP software and office productivity applications.
* Experience with GD&T (General Dimensioning and Tolerancing), ASME Y14
* Experience conducting Design of Experiments

**Other Skills and Abilities**

* Basic Knowledge of ISO and/or AS9100.
* HALT/HASS Testing
* Familiarity with MIL-STD 883
* LabView, MS Visio, MATLAB

**Employment eligibility**

* Due to the type of work at the facility and certain access restrictions, successful applicants must be a U.S. Person.

***What can Teledyne offer YOU?***  
A Competitive Salary & Benefits Package  
Excellent Health, Dental, Vision  
Paid Vacation Time  
Paid Sick Time  
Life Insurance Benefits  
Paid Holidays  
401(k) Eligibility  
Employee Stock Purchase Plan

You step into a highly automated blow molding operation where robots and PLCs hum from the night shift. Production is meeting targets, but there’s room to unlock more. You scan OEE dashboards, spot a trend on a cell with an ABB robot and an Omron PLC, and head to the floor. Within minutes, you’re shoulder‑to‑shoulder with Production and Maintenance, isolating the fault, optimizing the sequence, and shaving valuable minutes off cycle time. Later, you fine‑tune a newly commissioned automation cell, coach a teammate on a troubleshooting technique, and review a plan to pilot a new technology with a supplier partner. When an urgent issue pops up after hours, you jump in so the line stays on track.

### **What you will do**

* Master the operation and upkeep of ABB robots, Omron PLCs, and related automation used in blow molding.
* Partner with Production and Maintenance to diagnose and resolve issues that impact OEE.
* Lead reliability and performance upgrades across automation assets to keep production smooth.
* Support commissioning, installation, and precise tuning of automation systems for peak efficiency.

* Pursue reliability improvements that cut downtime and lift throughput across the plant.
* Provide hands‑on training and technical support to colleagues to spread best practices.
* Stay current on robotics, PLC programming, and broader automation advances.

* Notable OEE gains, especially via reduced downtime on robotic and PLC‑driven equipment.
* Rapid adoption of new technologies that shortens troubleshooting time and boosts efficiency.
* Tangible process optimizations that deliver performance improvements and cost savings.

You will make decisions that affect automation troubleshooting, equipment enhancements, and OEE improvement initiatives. Changes that significantly impact capacity or require major investment go to higher management for approval.

jobs.title: Lead Automation & Controls Engineer (Siemens TIA)
jobs.description:
**About EH Group Engineering**

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

**Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply.** This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems
* Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs
* Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7
* Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems
* Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic
* Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products
* Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures
* Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management
* Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements
* Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization
* Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

**Skills and Experience Required:**

* BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory
* Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role
* **Skill 1 :** Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus
* **Skill 2 :** Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements
* Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions
* Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management
* Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements
* Proven team player, with the ability to:
    
  *(i)* Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing **Skill 1** and **Skill 2** across the team  
  *(ii)*Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams
* Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

* Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus
* Professional working language is in English.

**Start date: Immediately**

The Controls and Avionics Solutions (CAS) business is experiencing unprecedented growth. Our two design centers in Endicott, New York and a new state of the art development center in Austin, Texas are the home for our next generation technical solutions. Engineers will develop flight and mission-critical products for more than 170 commercial and military customers. You will have the opportunity to help design and develop the next generation: Fly-By-Wire Flight Controls, Aircraft Engine Controls, Ground Vehicle Power Management Systems, Aircraft Electrification Systems, Advanced Air Mobility Systems, Autonomous Flight Systems, Flight Deck Systems, Cabin Management Systems, Weapon Control Systems, and Mission Systems for the world's most prominent commercial and military aircraft and vehicle manufacturers.
  
  
When you become a member of our team, you will work across multiple disciplines and collaborate with Systems, Hardware, Software, Test, and Operations during all phases of the Product Development Lifecycle. At BAE Systems, we promote a strong, collaborative culture and provide our employees with the tools, skills and training they need to succeed. We are all about trust, camaraderie, and a shared mission on delivering world-class products to our commercial and military customers. We offer a flexible hybrid work environment and 9/80 work schedule. Our company is part of the community and driven to improve our future and protect our freedom.
  
  
This role is based in Austin, TX and involves a combination of collaborative/in-person and independent work and will take the form of a hybrid work schedule, with time split between working onsite and remotely.
  
  
**Position Summary**
  
Join our team of Digital Circuit Design Engineers who are tasked with the architecture, design, test, and verification of high-reliability electronics circuit card assemblies. In this position you will provide electrical engineering support to a dynamic engineering development team, leading first unit test, design verification test, integration and transition to production tasks on complex digital circuit cards and modules.
  
The successful candidate must possess strong technical aptitude, communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally within the hardware organization and with other engineering disciplines/functions. Must be able to exercise discretion and independent judgment in technical areas.
  
This position may include the following activities:

* Design of complex high speed digital circuit card assemblies that utilize interfaces such as PCIe
* Schematic and layout capture of digital circuits such as FPGA’s and Microprocessors, including component selection, floor planning, power analysis, and timing analysis
* Signal integrity analysis utilizing software programs such as MATLAB and HyperLynx as well as hands-on high-speed signal integrity lab verification
* Develop and execute digital verification test procedures
* Experience with writing and executing test plans for environmental testing of high reliability electronics
* Support test and troubleshooting of systems, modules and sub-assemblies of digital modules, working directly with program engineering personnel as required
* Interface with Engineering, Operations, Quality and other supporting functions to drive defect resolution to root cause
* Generate and review the technical content of test procedures, drawings, engineering specifications, reports, Engineering Change Orders, and other documentation
* Interface with governmental customers and suppliers as required
* Mentor peers and junior engineers in areas of expertise
  

  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* BS in electrical engineering or equivalent and 12+ years of industry experience in Digital Circuit Design, or MS in electrical engineering or equivalent and 10+ years of industry experience in Digital Circuit Design
* Familiarity with high-speed digital design of circuit card assemblies, including simulation, PWB layout and routing, and signal integrity analysis.
* Experience with the design, build, integration and/or test of complex electronic systems.
* Able to research and apply electrical engineering principles and theories to solve electrical engineering problems.
* Communicates effectively both orally and in writing
* Exhibits sound interpersonal skills involving interfacing, coordinating, and negotiating with company personnel, customer, and suppliers
  

  
  
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**  

* BS in electrical engineering or equivalent and 15+ years of industry experience in Digital Circuit Design, or MS in electrical engineering or equivalent and 13+ years of industry experience in Digital Circuit Design
* FPGA based circuit card design.
* Embedded processors, PCIe, Ethernet, 1553, SERDES, Fiber Optic, DDR3/DDR4
* CAD based schematic capture and simulation (Mentor/Siemens Xpedition)
* Able to direct layout and routing rules
* Pre & Post routing simulation using HyperLynx
* Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills.
* Motivated self-starter with leadership skills and ability to effectively work in a team environment - Team Leader
* Excellent problem-solving skills, judgment, and analytical capability with demonstrated design success
* Ability to own the design and close on discrete tasking in a timely manner as well as lead others to closure
* Experience presenting technical information to program teams and/or customers.

Full-Time Salary Range: $132962 - $226035
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

jobs.description:
**Robotics Software Engineer (Engineer / Senior) – Austin, TX**

**Summary**  
The Robotics Software Engineer builds the software that makes the robots in our automated manufacturing cells aware of what is actually in front of them and able to react, rather than repeating a taught path. This role owns the robotics software stack for our cells from sensor input through motion, integrates arms, grippers, sensors, and cameras alongside the PLC and SCADA layers, and supports commissioning on site. You will be early enough to shape how we do robotics software, and close enough to the floor to see whether it works. We are hiring at the Engineer and Senior levels; scope and independence scale with level.

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Design and build the robotics software stack for our automated cells, from sensor input through motion.
* Write ROS 2 nodes for perception, planning, control, and coordination between machines.
* Integrate robot arms, grippers, sensors, and cameras into working cells alongside PLC and SCADA layers.
* Build simulation environments so behavior can be validated before it touches real hardware.
* Handle calibration, coordinate frames, and the tolerance stack-up that decides whether a part actually seats.
* Tune cycle time and reliability, then keep it there across shifts and part variation.
* Support commissioning and bring-up on site, including the debugging that only happens with real parts.

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechatronics, Electrical, Mechanical, or related engineering field, or equivalent experience.
* Engineer: 2+ years · Senior: 5+ years building robotics software that shipped on real hardware.
* Strong ROS 2 experience, including having shipped something on real hardware. A ROS 1–only background is not a fit for this role.
* Working knowledge of the ROS 2 stack itself: DDS middleware, QoS settings, lifecycle nodes, launch, and colcon builds.
* Proficiency in C++ and Python.
* Working knowledge of kinematics, transforms, motion planning, and trajectory execution.
* Experience integrating sensors and interpreting messy real-world data.
* Comfort with simulation tools such as Gazebo, Isaac Sim, or MuJoCo.
* Practical instinct for mechanical and electrical constraints, since the robot is one part of a larger machine.

**Level Expectations**  
Senior additionally owns the robotics software for a full cell end to end, makes the architecture calls inside it, leads integration with the controls and vision engineers, and mentors Engineer-level teammates.

Preferred Skills  

* Computer vision background: camera calibration, pose estimation, 2D and 3D detection, OpenCV.
* Deep learning for perception, including running inference on edge GPUs.
* MoveIt 2, ros2\_control, or Nav2.
* Industrial robot brands and their controllers, for example FANUC, UR, ABB, or KUKA.
* Force control, compliance, or assembly tasks with tight tolerances.
* Functional safety, risk assessment, or safety-rated hardware.
* Experience talking to PLCs from a robot stack over OPC UA or EtherNet/IP.
* Point cloud processing and 3D scanning.

**Compensation.** This role is eligible for equity (employee stock options) and benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off. Roles with significant travel may be eligible for an assignment premium.

jobs.title: Principal Systems Engineer, Signal-Path Performance & Modeling
jobs.description:
**About Neurophos**
===================

The demand for new data centers and AI compute is rapidly outpacing the planet's energy capacity. Digital solutions are hitting a power wall as we approach the physical limits of traditional silicon. Conquering this bottleneck means rethinking the fundamental architecture of inference compute. The industry's current path can't meet the need, so we're taking a different approach.

Instead of traditional electronic circuits, we use silicon photonics and an active, programmable metasurface to perform matrix multiplications at the speed of light. Our optical cells are 10,000x smaller than traditional photonic components, enabling unprecedented density. By using photonics instead of electricity, our chips become more efficient as they scale. This architecture will deliver up to 100 times the energy efficiency of existing solutions while significantly improving performance for large-scale AI inference.

We’ve assembled a world-class team of industry veterans and recently raised a $110M Series A led by Gates Frontier. Participants include M12 (Microsoft’s Venture Fund), Carbon Direct Capital, Aramco Ventures, Bosch Ventures, Tectonic Ventures, Space Capital, and others.

Join us and shape the future of computing!

**Location:** Austin, TX. Full-time onsite position.

**Reports To:** Chief Systems Engineer

**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking a highly skilled Systems Engineer to own the quantitative, end-to-end performance model of our optical vector-matrix multiplication (OVMM) engine. This role is the technical center of Systems Engineering's performance-modeling focus area: you will lead the end-to-end modeling, analysis, and architectural definition of high-speed communication and signal-processing systems. In this role, you will build and maintain the link and power budgets; quantify impairments and non-idealities across the optical, analog, and digital domains; develop mathematical and behavioral models; define the hardware and algorithmic techniques required to meet aggressive system-level performance targets; and determine how accuracy, throughput, and power trade against one another as the architecture evolves.

You will spend most of your time running system-level simulations and translating them into defensible allocations the rest of the organization can design against. If you have deep communication-theory and signal-processing intuition, are fluent in turning a signal chain into a quantitative model, and want to be the person who can answer "where does the system actually lose its margin," this role will let you define the performance envelope of a first-of-its-kind computing platform.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Primary Responsibilities**

* **Signal-Path Architecture Ownership:** Own and define the architecture of the high-speed communication and signal-processing system that converts the digital data stream into an optical signal and back—spanning digital signal processing, D/A and A/D conversion, and the analog/optical signal conditioning surrounding them on both the transmit and receive sides. Define the blocks and processing stages that comprise this system and specify the requirements for each. Negotiate block-level requirements with the photonic and mixed-signal implementation teams who build to this architecture.
* **Link & Power Budget Ownership:** Own and maintain the end-to-end optical and electrical link/power budget for this signal path, keeping it synchronized with the as-designed and as-measured hardware as the architecture evolves.
* **Signal-Path Modeling:** Build and maintain the reference behavioral model of the full TX–channel–RX signal path, capturing optical, analog, quantization, and algorithmic effects with the fidelity needed for architecture decisions and requirements allocation.
* **Accuracy & Performance Allocation:** Allocate NMSE/SNR/SNDR targets across optics, analog, quantization, and algorithmic domains, and update those allocations as component and architecture choices change.
* **Impairment Analysis:** Characterize and model optical, analog, and digital impairments—noise, distortion, jitter, quantization effects, crosstalk, mismatch, and nonlinearity—and quantify their impact on system-level accuracy.
* **Throughput & Efficiency Trade Studies:** Analyze the impact of TX/RX channel configurations and architectural options on TOPS, TOPS/W, and latency. Balance the complexity, risk, and time-to-market of proposed architectural solutions.
* **Monte Carlo & Time-Domain Simulation:** Develop and run statistical (Monte Carlo, corner) and time-domain simulations to quantify design margin and manufacturing robustness.
* **Model-to-Measurement Correlation:** Correlate model predictions with laboratory and silicon measurements; when measured performance does not match simulation, isolate the source of the discrepancy and refine the architecture, model, and allocations accordingly.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

* Represent this system's architecture in roadmap and planning discussions.
* Supply quantitative performance data, both predicted and measured, to support other efforts across Neurophos (e.g., customer-facing technical discussions).
* Support calibration accuracy-budget definition with sensitivity analysis.
* Collaborate with analog, photonic, digital, and software engineers to keep subsystem designs consistent with the architecture and its performance targets.
* Mentor engineers in system modeling, communication theory, and architecture/trade-study methodology.
* Contribute to intellectual property creation, including invention disclosures and patents.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer – Medium Voltage - Power Distribution & Control Products
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Integrated Circuit Solutions (ICS) is seeking a Medium Voltage Electrical Engineer to provide engineering expertise and product application support for medium-voltage electrical power distribution, protection, and control solutions. This role supports the design, application, analysis, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of medium-voltage power distribution systems.

The engineer will help select equipment, support proposals and procurement, evaluate vendors, and contribute to project execution. Working with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams, this role helps deliver safe, reliable, code-compliant, and cost-effective electrical solutions.

**Areas of Technical Expertise**

* Medium-voltage metal-clad and metal-enclosed switchgear and circuit breakers
* Load-break and disconnect switches
* Transformers, motor control centers (MV MCCs), VFDs, and soft starters
* Protection and control systems, protective relays, metering, and power monitoring
* Automatic and manual transfer schemes
* Grounding systems and equipment
* E-Houses, power distribution centers (PDCs), and integrated power racks/skids
* Capacitor banks and power factor correction equipment

**Key Responsibilities**

* Product and Application Engineering
* Review customer requirements, specifications, and project documentation to develop medium-voltage power distribution solutions.
* Select and apply medium-voltage equipment, including switchgear, transformers, motor control equipment, protective relays, and associated components.
* Determine equipment ratings and configurations based on system requirements, applicable standards, and project objectives.
* Develop and review electrical drawings, technical documentation, and equipment layouts.
* Evaluate equipment and system designs for safety, reliability, maintainability, and code compliance.

**Technical Support and System Design**

* Review system voltage, load requirements, available fault current, equipment ratings, protection requirements, grounding methods, and coordination considerations.
* Perform or review power system studies, including short-circuit, protective device coordination, load-flow, arc-flash, motor-starting, and voltage-drop analyses.
* Develop and review protection schemes for feeders, transformers, motors, buses, and other medium-voltage equipment, including protective relays, CTs, PTs/VTs, metering, and relay settings.
* Support system design, equipment integration, reliability, maintainability, selectivity, and overall performance.
* Support integration of switchgear, transformers, MV MCCs, VFDs, soft starters, protective relays, PLC/control systems, SCADA, metering, and communication networks.
* Support installation, startup, energization, testing, and commissioning; assist with troubleshooting relay operations, nuisance trips, control issues, communication failures, and other system events.

**Protection, Control, and Automation**

* Develop and review medium-voltage protection and control philosophies and protective relay functions.
* Develop and review breaker control, interlocking, transfer, permissive, synchronization, and trip schemes.
* Review DC control power systems, including batteries, chargers, UPS systems, and associated distribution.
* Support integration of protective relays and intelligent electronic devices (IEDs) with PLC, SCADA, DCS, and power management systems.
* Review communication architectures and protocols, including Modbus, IEC 61850, DNP3, and Ethernet/IP.
* Support control narratives, sequence-of-operations documents, cause-and-effect matrices, interlocking logic, and system testing.

**Codes, Standards, and Power System Studies**

* Apply applicable NEC/NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, IEEE, ANSI, NEMA, UL, customer specifications, and local codes.
* Review equipment interrupting and short-time withstand ratings, momentary ratings, BIL, insulation levels, enclosure ratings, environmental requirements, and electrical clearances.
* Evaluate arc-resistant equipment requirements and accessibility classifications where specified.
* Review power system studies and evaluate results to verify equipment ratings, protection requirements, and system performance.
* Identify specification deviations, exceptions, and technical risks and coordinate design changes.

**Project, Manufacturing, and Customer Support**

* Support projects from quotation and order entry through engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing, shipment, installation, energization, and commissioning.
* Review engineering drawings, bills of material, technical submittals, protection schemes, relay settings, equipment configurations, and vendor documentation.
* Coordinate technical requirements with switchgear, transformer, relay, MV drive, and other equipment suppliers.
* Support manufacturing teams in resolving technical and production issues.
* Participate in design reviews, factory acceptance tests (FATs), customer inspections, relay testing, equipment functional testing, and technical meetings.
* Investigate non-conformances, field issues, equipment failures, nuisance trips, and protection or application concerns; recommend corrective actions.
* Support sales and proposal teams with quotations, equipment selection, system configurations, technical specifications, customer discussions, and value engineering.

***Required Qualifications***

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
* Experience with medium-voltage power distribution systems, including switchgear, substations, motor control, protection, or engineered electrical equipment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of medium-voltage power distribution, protection, and control systems.
* Ability to develop, read, and review one-line and three-line diagrams, schematics, AC/DC control diagrams, wiring diagrams, equipment layouts, and technical specifications.
* Working knowledge of power system fundamentals, including short-circuit calculations

ENER-i is a cutting-edge software solution from Electric Power Engineers (EPE) helping utility clients plan for the rapidly evolving electric grid and achieve their planning and operational goals through innovative digitalization. Backed by the collective expertise of EPE, ENER-i brings decades of industry engineering experience to the world of cloud-based, enterprise computing software. ENER-i's goal is to create a shared, secure, curated data platform, providing engineers with the means for intelligent data aggregation, insightful engineering analytics engines, GIS, network connectivity models, machine learning & augmented intelligence. Our mission is to close the gap between planning and operations; transmission and distribution and merge the interests of the government, the public, and private industry.

The Software Power Systems Engineer will work as a core member of the ENER-i software development team, owning the power systems engineering behind the platform's analysis modules from algorithm design through production code. This involves designing, developing, testing, and validating scalable engines and workflows for distribution system analysis. Such analyses include but are not limited to: quasi-static time-series (QSTS) unbalanced power flow, hosting capacity and DER interconnection screening, automated thermal and voltage violation mitigation, value of DER and non-wires alternatives analysis, flexible interconnection, reliability analyses, resiliency analyses, and DERMS operational planning, and long-term capacity and investment planning.

**Company Overview**

Decision Technologies Inc. is a forward-thinking company specializing in technical support services and engineering consultancy. With extensive expertise in RF systems and missile sensors development, we are committed to delivering exceptional support, quality, and innovation to our clients across the defense and aerospace sectors.

Decision Technologies is seeking an experienced, high-impact **Air Defense/AAW Senior Systems Engineer** ready to take the next major step in their career trajectory by serving as the principal technical direction engineer embedded within a major U.S. Navy weapon system program office. **This is a 100% in-office (Arlington, VA), on-site position sitting inside the Navy program office spaces. This position is not eligible for hybrid or remote work arrangements.**

**Position Description:**

This role is tailored for an accomplished surface weapons or combat systems engineer, especially those with direct experience at OEMs and Labs/Warfare Centers who are looking to move beyond isolated subsystem tasks and transition into high-visibility technical leadership across the Navy enterprise. Embedded directly with program leadership, you will partner with the Government Technical Director to steer future weapon capability, analyze real-world operational feedback from the Fleet, and translate emerging threat intelligence into actionable science & technology (S&T) roadmaps for the next generation of surface munitions and ship self-defense capabilities.

**YOU MUST HAVE AN ACTIVE DOD SECRET CLEARANCE / TOP SECRET PREFERRED**

**Responsibilities**

The selectee will serve as the Decision Technologies Lead Systems Engineer for U.S. Navy Terminal Defense Systems engineering support. In this capacity, you will drive top-level engineering analysis, architectural roadmapping, and operational alignment across the portfolio:

* **Strategic Planning & S&T Roadmapping:** Lead technical, programmatic, and architectural roadmapping across the entire IWS 11 portfolio. Identify, evaluate, and transition emerging Science & Technology (S&T) and R&D solutions to formulate future weapon system upgrade evolutions.
* **Operational Fleet Feedback & Threat Analysis:** Serve as the trusted technical advisor to the Government Technical Director, keeping a constant pulse on real-world operational challenges, Fleet feedback, and live combat engagements to rapidly inform near-term CONOPS and long-term capability baselines.
* **Threat vs. Weapon Systems Requirements Analysis:** Analyze cutting-edge threat intelligence and emerging adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) against current and planned surface weapon capabilities to identify gaps, update weapon specifications, and drive survivability solutions.

* **Digital Engineering Leadership:** Guide the program office’s model-based transition by applying Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) frameworks (SysML, Cameo/MagicDraw), digital threads, and Agile/DevSecOps practices to weapons modernization lifecycles.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** *Master’s Degree* in a science, engineering, technology, or mathematics (STEM) discipline (or *Bachelor’s Degree* with equivalent demonstrated experience directly with U.S. Navy surface weapon systems or combat systems).
* **Experience:** 10 years of systems engineering experience with U.S. Navy surface weapon systems, surface combat systems (e.g., SSDS, Aegis), or naval guided munitions.
* **Clearance:** Active DoD **SECRET** clearance required (Top Secret eligible preferred); ability to access SIPRNet and handle classified intelligence/threat briefings.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Master’s Degree in a science, engineering, technology, or math discipline.
* Direct technical experience with Navy terminal defense elements, including the **Rolling Airframe Missile (RAM)** and **Close-In Weapon System (CIWS)** weapon systems, launchers, and guided missile rounds.
* Proven track record leading requirements analysis, weapon specification development, and System Engineering Technical Reviews (SETR) according to the NAVSEA Technical Review Manual (TRM).
* Practical familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools and architectures (e.g., Cameo Systems Modeler, MagicDraw, SysML, DoDAF).
* Working knowledge of weapon-to-combat system interface documentation (ICDs, IRSs), firing policies, and combat system designation loops.
* Excellent executive briefing, written communication, and cross-functional leadership skills with the poise to advise military program managers, technical directors, and international steering committees.

**Travel Requirements**

* Limited travel required (~10%), primarily to warfare centers, test facilities, or OEM plant locations (e.g., Dahlgren, VA; Port Hueneme, CA; China Lake, CA; Tucson, AZ).

**Who we are**

Lockheed Martin is a global leader in aerospace, defense, and technology solutions. Our Manassas campus is a thriving center of engineering expertise, fostering a culture that encourages creativity, excellence, and the creation of exceptional products. Our team is made up of dedicated professionals who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

At Lockheed Martin, we're at the forefront of cutting-edge technology and innovation. Our campus in Manassas, Virginia is a hub for engineering excellence, where we tackle some of the world's most challenging engineering problems. We pride ourselves on our culture of creativity, excellence, and product innovation.

**The Work**

Lockheed Martin Rotary & Mission Systems is seeking a full-time Systems Engineer. This Systems Engineer will support the United Kingdom (UK) Tactical Tomahawk Weapons Control System (TTWCS) program within our C6ISR market segment at our Manassas, Virginia location. This individual will be part of a small team responsible for maintaining UK customer requirements, system hardware requirements, and interface specifications, for addressing a variety of systems engineering tasks, and defining and executing a test and acceptance program for the Tomahawk Weapon System (TWS) onboard UK Astute-class submarines.

This position involves frequent interaction and collaboration with customers and end-users. The ability to build and maintain positive relationships with stakeholders, including customers, end-users, and internal teams, is essential.

This Systems Engineer must also participate in the full System Engineering life cycle, including system and hardware requirements development, hardware stand-up, system integration, test definition, test planning, system certification and sell-off, and system delivery and production support. The Systems Engineer should demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and a desire to optimize team efficiency throughout the entire lifecycle.

This position requires occasional international travel to the UK for several weeks at a time, as well as occasional local and domestic travel.

Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life

Joining Lockheed Martin means becoming part of a team that's making a significant impact in the field of engineering. When you choose to work with us, you'll enjoy:

* An excellent working environment equipped with state-of-the-art tools.
* The opportunity to work alongside industry leaders and top-notch professionals.

* Experience in Systems Engineering for mission critical applications
* Mission and/or vehicle systems engineering experience
* Software coding or scripting experience

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Failure analysis or fault management technical experience
* Experience with Systems Engineering process
* Experience defining requirements & interfaces
* Understanding of spacecraft integration & test, launch, and mission operations

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Core Product
jobs.description:
**About Tin Can**
=================

Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We’re creating screen-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today’s digital world.

We’re building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler & better for their kids than the tech-infused lives we’re currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it). As we gear up to scale to thousands of families, we’re ready to bring on two engineers to help make it happen.

**The Role**
------------

A Tin Can earns its spot on the kitchen counter when a kid keeps picking it up. Because we build both ends of the call, we get to make things no other phone can, and the next ones are the kind families ask us for: an easier way to fill the contact book, even more speed dials, more a kid can do without waiting on a grown-up. We’re hiring two Software Engineers to own the core product — the features that give a kid someone to call, a reason to call, and an easy way to do it.

You’ll build across the whole product: the app parents live in (Flutter), the TypeScript services on AWS Lambda behind contacts, plans, call logs, and voicemail, and the call-routing service that gates every call. You’ll sit with the Head of Product and the core experience’s PM and designer, alongside the engineers who own our voice platform, firmware, and account portal. When a feature reaches into the call path — a new hotline number, the voicemail menu — you’ll go there, with our voice engineers reviewing anything on the SIP and media plane.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Make it easier to hear who called and call them back — on the phone itself, in our services, and in the parents’ app
* Give kids more of the phone: even more speed dials, and more a kid can set up alone, with a parent’s say-so
* Make the first week count — improved contact syncing, faster contact approvals, and a first run that has a family calling on day one
* Build the fun, weird features no other landline can, the kind a kid tells their friends about
* Own the call-routing rules a feature needs — what a speed dial or a hotline number does, who a kid can reach — in the service every call goes through
* Build the tooling behind hotlines — scheduling, uploading, playback — with the engineers who own our voice platform
* Spec and build the service side of features whose other half is firmware — what the phone plays, how it rings — with the firmware engineer
* Instrument what you ship — event schema, dashboard, alarm — so we can see kids calling more, week by week
* Take a turn in our on-call rotation, because nobody knows a feature like the person who built it

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3+ years building user-facing software, including a feature you took from idea to production and kept running
* Strong TypeScript; you’ve built and run an API in production (ours run on AWS Lambda with Postgres) and can model contacts, permissions, and call history
* You’ve shipped a mobile or web client people use every day; our app is Flutter, and we’ll teach you Dart
* You think about the kid and the parent at once — what a kid can do alone, what needs a grown-up, and how fast “no” takes effect
* Fluency using AI as a multiplier across prototyping, build, and analysis; this is how we work, not a nice-to-have
* Hands-on and scrappy; you’d rather prototype the flow on a real Tin Can than wait for a perfect spec
* A clear communicator who writes things down, and a collaborative, low-ego approach — everyone here sweeps the floor
* Based in Seattle and ready to work from our office Monday through Thursday; this isn’t a remote role
* **Bonus:** Flutter or Dart; curiosity about telephony (dial plans, IVRs, text-to-speech); a product for kids or families; or Stripe, Shopify, or IoT integrations

**Why Join Tin Can**
====================

* **We’re building tech that protects childhood:** We’re on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. No doomscrolling, data mining, or dopamine traps — just a simpler, better way for kids to stay in touch. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters.
* **You’ll own the reason a kid picks up the phone:** Reliability makes a call connect; you’ll build what makes a kid want to make one — easier ways to call back, more speed dials, more to do when no one’s around — and see it in how often families call.
* **Small, high-trust team:** Every company says “team,” but at Tin Can it means something different. We’re a small, mission-driven group that genuinely has each other’s backs — professionally and personally. You’ll be joining a tight-knit crew where your ideas and instincts matter from day one.
* **Room to explore, not just execute:** You’ll have the space to challenge assumptions, solve hard problems, and build systems that reflect our values of trust, simplicity, and care.

If you’re excited by making a Tin Can the thing a kid reaches for when they’ve got something to tell someone — and building what makes that call easy to make and return — we’d love to meet you.

Compensation Range: $145K - $175K

**Optical Communications Software Engineer – Modem Integration** 
**Bright Silicon Technologies | Pleasanton, CA | Full time**
==============================================================================================================================

**About the Role**
==================

Bright Silicon Technologies (BST) develops precision optical systems built around our Lightfield Directing Array (LDA), a MEMS micromirror array for fast, precise control of light. Our OCTANE free-space optical communications terminal brings together free-space optics, fiber-based photonics, and communications hardware to enable high-bandwidth links between ground and airborne platforms.  
  
We’re looking for a software engineer to own modem integration and communications software for OCTANE. You’ll build the software that configures and monitors our (expected to be a COMET) modem, connects it to the terminal’s data interfaces, and manages link operation and recovery. Working with our photonics, firmware, controls, and hardware engineers, you’ll take a working laboratory system toward reliable outdoor and mobile operation, targeting Space Development Agency (SDA) interoperability.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* Own modem software integration for our free space optical communications terminal. Develop C/C++ software for modem configuration, telemetry, host interfaces, network interface and data transfer.
* Define software interfaces and acceptance criteria, including applicable SDA Optical Communications Terminal (OCT) requirements. Coordinate link states and timing with pointing, acquisition, and tracking (PAT) software.
* Implement link state machines, startup and shutdown sequences, fault handling, and recovery after fades or interruptions.
* Build Python tools and automated bench and hardware-in-the-loop tests. Measure throughput, latency, packet loss, and bit error rate to verify link performance.
* Troubleshoot problems across software, embedded interfaces, modem behavior, interfaces with the next level up in the network, and optical performance

**What we’re looking for**
==========================

* A bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, and at least three years of modem integration and communications software development experience.
* Strong C/C++ skills and experience developing and debugging software on Linux or real-time embedded platforms.
* Hands-on experience integrating communications hardware and debugging hardware/software interfaces using logs, telemetry, protocol captures, and laboratory measurements.
* Experience using Python or a similar language for test automation and data analysis, with working knowledge of communications performance measurements.
* U.S. citizenship.

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience with SDA OCT standards, compliant optical terminals, or modem and terminal interoperability testing.
* Experience with COMET or other optical communications modems, including configuration, telemetry, and host integration.
* Experience with free-space or fiber-optic communications, including optical link budgets, receiver sensitivity, and the effects of changing received power.
* Familiarity with communications or modem DSP, including modulation, synchronization, framing, forward error correction, or equalization.
* Experience integrating software with FPGA-based systems, including register interfaces and data paths.
* Experience validating link state machines and fault recovery through hardware-in-the-loop testing or field demonstrations on mobile platforms.

*Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At BST we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*

**Why BST**
===========

* Own the software that connects OCTANE’s modem and terminal hardware into a working optical communications link, from bench integration through outdoor testing.
* Work closely with colleagues in photonics, firmware, controls, and electronics. Follow problems across interfaces and see the results in operating hardware.
* Take meaningful technical ownership in an engineer-led company with competitive compensation, equity, and a sustainable approach to work.

**Company Overview**
====================

At Bright, we build precision optical systems to guide data for a new era of communication. Our team combines precision engineering, optical design, and product development to commercialize the Lightfield Directing Array. Applications include laser communications, optical switching for data centers, lidar, and additive manufacturing.  
Founded in 2020, Bright Silicon Technologies is building an enduring technology manufacturing company. You’ll contribute to the development, launch, and scaling of advanced optical products. We offer competitive salaries and equity incentives, and we value effective engineering alongside long-term work/life balance.  
  
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

At VMware by Broadcom, we are building new possibilities for our customers by accelerating digital business transformation. ESXi Operating System is at the core of VMware Cloud Foundation's (VCF) virtualization technology. It is a platform built from scratch for the explicit purpose of running virtual machines and containers. ESXi is widely used by most large corporations, due to its advanced capabilities, performance, and quality.

The VMKernel Core team is responsible for the design, implementation, and architectural direction of the VMKernel – the operating system kernel for ESXi. The VMKernel Core team works across ESXi but its focus is the core kernel subsystems providing key functionality used by other groups within VMware by Broadcom as well as partner companies.

As an engineer on the core team, you will

* Learn the tools and processes necessary to become a successful VMKernel engineer and will participate in the design and development of novel operating system techniques and algorithms for managing both virtual and real computer hardware.

* Work with multiple engineering teams to architect, design, implement and deliver new products based on the enterprise-class VCF virtualization platform.
* Take on opportunities to own parts of the core kernel infrastructures and with experience, take on ownership and lead larger parts of projects.

* BS degree in Computer Science or related field and 8+ years of relevant industry experience. Or MS degree in Computer Science or related field and 6+ years of relevant industry experience. Or PhD and 3+ years of relevant industry experience
* Strong understanding of kernel-level OS architectures such as Linux, Unix, Solaris, BSD-like systems, Windows, embedded real-time Operating Systems

new_jobs.description:

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience programming in C++, Java, Python, Kotlin or Go.
* 5 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
* 5 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.
* Experience with machine learning, large language models, Python, and machine learning optimization.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in machine learning, or 5 years of industry experience in applied machine learning/machine learning research.
* Expertise in NLP, LLM, computer vision.
* Knowledge of android framework.
* Strong programming skills in Python, C++.
* Passionate and respectful team player, and ability to grow the team, with leadership and collaboration skills, as well as excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started - and as a manager, you guide the way.  
  
With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

  

Our team is transforming Android into the premier AI-powered operating system by integrating agentic capabilities. Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and advanced machine learning, we redefine mobile interactions through agents that fulfill complex user requests via UI automation, tool calling, and hybrid architectures.

In this role, you will manage cutting-edge technical challenges, including building and deploying sophisticated LLM solutions, developing agents that interpret screen content, understand user behavior, and execute actions through APIs, enhancing model efficiency and latency for mobile hardware, and partnering with GDM on pre-training and post-training Gemma models specifically for computer use and tool calling.

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

* Develop AI agents that effectively understands user behavior, screen content and use tools/APIs.
* Optimize ML models for on-device performance.
* Work closely with the GDM, Gemma Frontier, Gemini app, and Android framework teams.

new_jobs.title: Electrical or Embedded Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Work at Blissway: Opportunity for Impact Every Day**

Blissway is a startup that simplifies toll collection and dramatically improves highway safety. We are multiple startups in one: **Deep Tech, AI/ML, Hardware, SaaS, and IoT.** For the past five years, we have built a nearly insurmountable technological lead in tolling, a roughly $200B global industry expected to double in the next decade. We work for toll authorities and state DOTs, and we own the whole system, from the roadside camera to the final bill, so every vehicle we see becomes one accurate toll transaction and nothing more. While our competitors have thousands of employees, we operate with a lean but growing team of less than 30. Our impact is visible on the massive Interstate Highway System connecting every major US metro (except Juneau, AK—sorry, Juneau).

**You are a good fit if...**

* **You love the grind:** You take ownership and put in the time to meet deadlines. Our recent team survey showed an average of 55 hours/week, with occasional 70+ hour bursts for major releases.
* **You are detail obsessed:** You have experience writing code, designing or building systems that stands up to the unpredictability of the physical world, where the small details are the difference between success and failure.
* **You are adaptable:** We are a lean team. If you only want to work on a "niche thing" or are uncomfortable helping other teams when they need a boost, this isn't the place for you. We expect you to figure out what you need to get stuff done.

* **You're not afraid to code:** This is a hardware-centered role but most of our teammates have broad skillsets that allow them to build what they need, including code to help make our hardware more effective. At minimum you should be comfortable sketching what you need and collaborating with software engineers to build it. We mostly use Python, but we don’t care what you’re most proficient in today as long as you learn fast.
* **You value working together in person:** You’re excited to work alongside the team at our Denver office. This role is in-office five days a week, Monday through Friday, with flexibility to work remotely occasionally when needed.

**The Mission: From Theory to High-Traffic Reality** At a team of less than 30, we don't have "junior" tasks. You will be given immediate ownership over the hardware that keeps the Interstate Highway System running. You will use the basics of electrical, mechanical, and software engineering to:

* **Optimize the Edge:** Improve the reliability of cameras, detectors, and night-time illuminators that survive 24/7 exposure.
* **Prototyping & R&D:** Design circuit schematics and PCBs for new hardware integrations that push our device performance further.
* **Full-Stack Hardware:** Write the on-device code (Python/C++) to integrate new sensors and ensure the servers can handle the incoming data.
* **Build for Scale:** Iterate on CAD models to make our assembly process faster and more robust.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* **Education:** Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. We are open to 2027 grads but may run those applications through a separate cohort.
* **Portfolio of "Things":** A track record of actually building physical hardware. Whether it’s high-impact internships, senior design projects, or a workbench full of hobbyist electronics (Raspberry Pi, ESP32, custom PCBs), we want to see what you’ve brought to life.
* **Technical Versatility:** You have a foundational understanding of circuit design and CAD, but you aren't afraid to write code. You should be comfortable (or eager to become comfortable) in Python or C++ to make your hardware talk to our software.
* **Mindset:** You take extreme ownership. You don't wait for a manual or a step-by-step guide; you figure out what you need to get stuff done and you do it with a professional, collaborative mentality. You understand that in a small team feedback is the fastest way to level up, and you welcome it.

**Our Technical Ecosystem:** While we value problem-solving over specific syntax, skills that transfer well are:

* **Languages:** Python, TypeScript, C/C++
* **Tools: Altium,** Onshape, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers
* **Infrastructure:** Linux, IoT Edge Devices, AWS
* **Specialties:** Edge Computer Vision, CAD, weatherproofing, outdoor deployment, vertical product integration

**The Interview Process**

We're a selectively small team, which means a deliberate and thorough interview process with 3-4 interviews and a final paid work trial. In exchange, you get real autonomy from day one, direct access to the people setting technical direction, and work that ships to roads in weeks, not quarters.

**The Essentials (Health & Wealth)**

* **Relocation Support:** We are excited for you to join the team at our engineering office in Denver. We value in-person collaboration and daily team lunches and we provide a relocation bonus to help you get here.
* **Personalized Health Coverage (ICHRA):** We don’t believe in one-size-fits-all healthcare. We provide a monthly allowance for you and dependents so you can choose the individual plan that actually fits *your* life.
* **Investing in Your Future:** 401(k) matching up to 4%.
* **Peace of Mind:** Transparent compensation. Company-sponsored life & disability insurance.
* **Early Stage Equity:** Competitive equity package. Every year, we facilitate a tender process that gives you the opportunity to sell your vested shares at the same valuation as our investors.

**Rest & Recharge**

* **High-Trust Time Off:** 4 weeks of untracked PTO. We don't micromanage your calendar; we focus on your impact. Take the time you need to stay sharp and inspired.
* **Family First:** 12 weeks of paid parental leave for birth and adoptive parents. We want you present for the moments that matter most.

new_jobs.title: Staff Embedded Linux Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Full-Time

In Person: Boston, MA Headquarters

*Step into a foundational engineering role at a fast-growing grid intelligence company.*

We are seeking a **Staff Embedded Linux Engineer** to join our customer focused team, take charge of the Linux kernel, drivers, and bootloader beneath our current technology, and shape the embedded architecture of future generation products.

LineVision’s customers include eight of the ten largest US utilities, which rely on field deployed device sensors to run securely and reliably. You will work on ruggedized, solar-powered sensors mounted on poles away from the transmission lines they monitor. Each pairs a Linux compute module with a companion microcontroller, connects over cellular, and must run for years without a site visit.

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Embedded Software Engineering, you will have broad autonomy over kernel and bootloader maintenance, security patching, board bring-up, system software improvements, and device security, including secure boot. You will bridge a hardware-focused embedded team with Data Science and Computer Vision, moving algorithms onto the device and raising the team’s software depth, delivering LineVision devices that are lean, secure, and ready for what comes next.

Please note: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

### **Core Responsibilities and Key Performance Objectives**

* Maintain the Linux kernel and bootloader on LineVision devices, including security patching, driver development, and operating system improvements
* Lead board bring-up on new hardware platforms, from first boot through production
* Drive system software improvements across the device platform, including performance, power efficiency, and reliability
* Design hardware-level device security, including secure boot and factory-signed software, with hardware and manufacturing teams
* Work with Data Science and Computer Vision to adapt algorithms for low-footprint, on-device execution, using the NPU, GPU, and other hardware blocks where they save CPU and power
* Own the Linux BSP and build system for the platform, including device trees, OS image releases, and the kernel and bootloader upgrade strategy
* Lead root cause analysis on cross-layer problems such as kernel crashes, power and thermal behavior, and field or manufacturing failures that span hardware and software
* Influence SoC, module, and peripheral selection for future hardware, weighing Linux support, vendor BSP quality, long-term maintainability, and security features
* Set technical standards for embedded Linux through design reviews, code review, and mentoring, and act as the technical resource for engineers across hardware, firmware, and cloud application software

### **Within the first 3 months:**

* Assume day-to-day responsibility for kernel, driver, and bootloader work, with a documented security patching process
* Baseline current system performance, including boot time, shutdown time, and power draw
* Review the platform’s kernel, bootloader, and security posture and present a prioritized technical roadmap to Engineering leadership

### **Within the first 6 months:**

* Ship production system software improvements with measurable gains against the baseline
* Define the device security architecture and roadmap with Hardware Engineering, Manufacturing, and the security team, covering secure boot and chain of trust, signed software and updates, key management and factory provisioning, protection of debug and physical interfaces, data protection, and regulatory cybersecurity requirements such as EU RED

### **Within the first year:**

* Lead the embedded software architecture for the next generation sensor, covering OS, bootloader, update mechanism, and security, and document the decisions for the wider team
* Establish a repeatable workflow with Data Science and Computer Vision for moving models and algorithms onto the device
* Grow the team’s embedded Linux depth through design reviews, code review, and coaching, so kernel and driver work no longer depends on one person

**How to succeed in this role**
-------------------------------

### **Key Competencies**

* **Critical Thinking:** Develop frameworks for solving complex embedded problems, from kernel behavior to hardware interactions. Mentor teammates in structured debugging and root cause analysis.
* **Delivering Innovative Solutions:** Develop strategies for the device software platform, including the next generation, and guide the team in executing them.
* **Empowering Others:** Coach engineers on Linux and software practices while learning about LineVision’s hardware from teammates. Drive initiatives that develop the team.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Develop approaches for working with Data Science, Computer Vision, and hardware teams. Influence decisions on what runs where on the device.

### **Essential Skills**

* Linux kernel and device driver development in C, including device trees and common bus and camera interfaces
* Bootloader development (U-Boot or similar) and board bring-up of new SoCs or modules
* Embedded Linux security patching and maintenance over a multi-year product life, including CVE triage and kernel upgrades
* A software engineering background with strong working knowledge of hardware: reading schematics and datasheets, debugging with JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers
* Scripting in Python and Bash
* A track record of technical leadership: setting direction for a platform or subsystem and raising the bar for the engineers around you

### **What Sets the Best Candidates Apart**

* Hardware-level device security experience, including secure boot, chain of trust, key management, and secure factory provisioning
* Experience optimizing embedded Linux for boot time, power, and reliability
* Experience running workloads on NPU

The Software Design Engineer is primarily responsible for developing software component design specifications, based on the software architecture design specification. The engineer will monitor the work of the software coders and testers, providing direction and clarification as needed, and work on the code themselves. Participate and occasionally lead code reviews, unit test reviews, and functional/integration test reviews.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

**About the Role**

  

We are seeking a Vice President to build and lead our Modern Management Platform function: the shared engineering team that owns how every Windows, macOS, iOS, Android and cloud PC endpoint in the enterprise is configured, secured, updated and measured. You will treat Microsoft Intune and its surrounding control plane as a product, delivering a reliable, well-governed platform that multiple endpoint, mobility and virtualization teams build on.

This is a new function in a highly regulated, multi-entity environment. The successful candidate will set the standards, operating model and team that the broader workplace engineering organization depends on.

Key Responsibilities

  
  

Platform & Tenant Ownership

* Own the Intune tenant as a platform, including tenant configuration, RBAC, scope tags, administrative units and change control.

* Govern a consistent multi-entity, multi-tenant management model, including tenant-to-tenant migration patterns and configuration parity.

* Serve as the accountable technical owner for the platform in audits, regulatory examinations and incident reviews.

Policy Architecture

* Design and govern endpoint policy across Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS and Android: configuration profiles, security baselines, compliance policies, update rings and app protection.

* Act as design authority for device-based Conditional Access in partnership with Identity and Information Security.

* Assess the platform impact of security and baseline changes before enterprise-wide rollout.

Application Deployment

* Own the Intune application deployment plane: assignment model, deployment rings, supersedence, dependencies and delivery telemetry.

* Define packaging standards and acceptance criteria, and partner with software and vulnerability management teams on remediation and upgrade campaigns.

Automation & Engineering Practices

* Build automation using Microsoft Graph, PowerShell and Power Automate to eliminate manual configuration, reconciliation and reporting.

* Establish configuration-as-code with source control, peer review and dev-to-production promotion for all policy and script artifacts.

Compliance, Telemetry & Reporting

* Define endpoint compliance baselines and measure drift against them.

* Deliver an authoritative device and configuration dataset and Power BI reporting for operations, audit and executive audiences.

Leadership

* Build, lead and develop a team of platform engineers

* Set and enforce engineering standards across peer teams, and run a clear intake and prioritization model for platform requests.

Chair a cross-team configuration review forum and maintain documentation, runbooks and roadmap.  

  

**Qualifications**

  

Required

Design the circuit boards that go inside radios operators trust with their lives

At Persistent Systems, our Wave Relay® MANET technology keeps warfighters, first responders, and critical missions connected in the most contested environments on earth. We're looking for a Hardware Engineer with deep experience in battery-powered, high-speed (GHz) digital circuit design. This role is for someone who wants their boards to end up in the field, not in a reference kit.

You'll design, develop, and prototype the electronic assemblies inside our next-generation radios and the upgrades to our current products. Your work spans concept through DVT, and into direct technical support for manufacturing. This lead engineer will set design direction across a project or small set of related projects and serve as a technical resource for others.

**What you'll work on**

* Defining system- and circuit-level requirements for next-generation radio products

* Providing technical leadership for projects developed by sub-contractors
* Ensuring deliverables meet performance, cost, and reliability targets on schedule
* Providing technical support to manufacturing

**The tooling you'll work with**

We invest in the tools that move engineers' output. You'll have day-one access to a modern hardware development environment:

* Serious lab infrastructure. Full RF and digital lab: high-bandwidth scopes, spectrum and vector network analyzers, thermal chambers, and the fixtures to characterize what you build.
* Direct hand-off to manufacturing. In-house manufacturing support, so the feedback loop from board bring-up to production issues is fast.

**Why hardware engineers choose Persistent Systems**

* You own boards from end-to-end. Concept, schematic, layout guidance, bring-up, DVT, and production support, one engineer, one board, real accountability.
* Independent, not a subsidiary. Product direction gets made by the people building the radios, not filtered through a Fortune 500 parent's roadmap review.
* Mission you can point to. Our radios are deployed with U.S. and allied forces, federal agencies, and public safety teams worldwide.

**Position Responsibilities**

* Architect hardware subsystems spanning multiple products
* Promote technical standards and best practices for the hardware team
* Resolve complex technical challenges across projects
* Partner with product management and adjacent engineering functions on tradeoffs
* Mentor other engineers and contribute to hiring decisions

* Excellent cross-functional communication skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

Description:

Are you an Electrical Controls Engineer who enjoys designing and building automated machinery, not just supporting production equipment?

At RapidVisionPak, you'll play a key role in developing innovative packaging systems used by food manufacturers across North America. Our equipment helps package many of the fresh, prepared, and convenience food products consumers see every day in grocery stores. As part of the Midera family of companies, RapidVisionPak combines entrepreneurial innovation with the strength and resources of a global leader in food processing and packaging technology.

**What You'll Do**

As an Electrical Controls Engineer, you will take ownership of controls systems from concept through customer installation.

You'll:

* Design electrical control systems for automated packaging machinery
* Program and troubleshoot Allen-Bradley PLCs and HMIs
* Develop machine software using Ladder Logic and Structured Text
* Configure servo systems, motion control, VFDs, industrial networks, and safety devices
* Integrate machine vision and advanced automation technologies
* Support machine startup, commissioning, and customer installations
* Work closely with Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing, Service, and customers to deliver industry-leading equipment solutions

**Why Join RapidVisionPak?**

* Competitive salary: **$100,000-$120,000 DOE**
* Annual incentive bonus opportunity
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Work on highly customized automation projects
* Exposure to machine vision, robotics, and emerging AI-enabled technologies
* Direct impact on products used by leading food manufacturers throughout North America
* Stable, growing organization with a collaborative engineering culture

**Location**

Appleton, Wisconsin

**Apply Today**

If you're looking for an opportunity to design innovative automation solutions, work directly with customers, and help shape the future of packaging technology, we'd like to hear from you.

Requirements:

**What We're Looking For**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Automation Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of Controls Engineering experience
* Allen-Bradley PLC programming experience utilizing Studio 5000
* Experience with Ladder Logic and Structured Text
* Electrical schematic and control panel design experience
* Knowledge of servo systems, motion control, VFDs, sensors, and industrial automation
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Ability to travel approximately 15-20%

**Ideal Backgrounds:**

* Packaging machinery
* Food processing equipment
* Automated manufacturing equipment
* Machine builders/OEMs
* Robotics or machine vision integration
* FDA-regulated manufacturing environments
